# Analytics API



# Analytics API [#analytics-api]

The Analytics API provides access to delivery metrics, engagement data, geographic breakdowns, and provider-level statistics. Use these endpoints to monitor your sending performance and optimize your email strategy.

## Heatmap [#heatmap]

Retrieve hourly engagement data across days of the week. Use this to identify the best times to send emails.

```
GET /analytics/heatmap
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters]

| Parameter  | Type   | Default     | Description                                           |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `metric`   | string | `opens`     | Metric to plot: `opens`, `clicks`, `deliveries`       |
| `from`     | string | 30 days ago | Start date (ISO 8601, e.g., `2026-03-01`)             |
| `to`       | string | today       | End date (ISO 8601)                                   |
| `timezone` | string | `UTC`       | Timezone for hour bucketing (e.g., `America/Toronto`) |

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/heatmap?metric=opens&from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-19&timezone=America/Toronto" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "metric": "opens",
  "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2026-03-19T23:59:59.999Z",
  "timezone": "America/Toronto",
  "data": [
    { "day": 0, "hour": 9, "value": 142 },
    { "day": 0, "hour": 10, "value": 187 },
    { "day": 1, "hour": 9, "value": 156 },
    { "day": 1, "hour": 14, "value": 203 }
  ]
}
```

The `day` field is 0-indexed (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday). The `hour` field is 0--23 in the requested timezone.

***

## Geographic [#geographic]

Retrieve engagement data broken down by country and optionally by region.

```
GET /analytics/geographic
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters-1]

| Parameter | Type   | Default     | Description                                                  |
| --------- | ------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `metric`  | string | `opens`     | Metric: `opens`, `clicks`, `deliveries`                      |
| `from`    | string | 30 days ago | Start date (ISO 8601)                                        |
| `to`      | string | today       | End date (ISO 8601)                                          |
| `country` | string | --          | Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., `CA`, `US`) |

### Example Request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/geographic?metric=opens&from=2026-03-01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-1]

```json
{
  "metric": "opens",
  "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2026-03-19T23:59:59.999Z",
  "data": [
    { "country": "CA", "countryName": "Canada", "value": 4521, "percentage": 42.3 },
    { "country": "US", "countryName": "United States", "value": 3890, "percentage": 36.4 },
    { "country": "GB", "countryName": "United Kingdom", "value": 891, "percentage": 8.3 },
    { "country": "DE", "countryName": "Germany", "value": 456, "percentage": 4.3 }
  ],
  "total": 10692
}
```

***

## Providers [#providers]

Retrieve delivery and engagement metrics broken down by email provider (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, etc.). Use this to identify deliverability issues with specific providers.

```
GET /analytics/providers
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters-2]

| Parameter | Type    | Default     | Description                                |
| --------- | ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `from`    | string  | 30 days ago | Start date (ISO 8601)                      |
| `to`      | string  | today       | End date (ISO 8601)                        |
| `limit`   | integer | `10`        | Number of top providers to return (max 50) |

### Example Request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/providers?from=2026-03-01&limit=5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-2]

```json
{
  "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2026-03-19T23:59:59.999Z",
  "data": [
    {
      "provider": "Gmail",
      "domain": "gmail.com",
      "sent": 5200,
      "delivered": 5180,
      "bounced": 12,
      "opened": 2340,
      "clicked": 890,
      "complained": 2,
      "deliveryRate": 99.6,
      "openRate": 45.2,
      "clickRate": 17.2
    },
    {
      "provider": "Outlook",
      "domain": "outlook.com",
      "sent": 3100,
      "delivered": 3050,
      "bounced": 35,
      "opened": 1220,
      "clicked": 410,
      "complained": 5,
      "deliveryRate": 98.4,
      "openRate": 40.0,
      "clickRate": 13.4
    }
  ],
  "total": {
    "sent": 10692,
    "delivered": 10590,
    "bounced": 72,
    "opened": 4580,
    "clicked": 1620,
    "complained": 8
  }
}
```

***

## Export [#export]

Export raw analytics data as CSV or JSON for external analysis.

```
GET /analytics/export
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters-3]

| Parameter    | Type   | Default     | Description                                                                       |
| ------------ | ------ | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from`       | string | 30 days ago | Start date (ISO 8601)                                                             |
| `to`         | string | today       | End date (ISO 8601)                                                               |
| `format`     | string | `json`      | Export format: `json` or `csv`                                                    |
| `metrics`    | string | all         | Comma-separated metrics: `deliveries`, `bounces`, `opens`, `clicks`, `complaints` |
| `groupBy`    | string | `day`       | Aggregation period: `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`                                |
| `categories` | string | --          | Comma-separated categories to filter by                                           |

### Example Request (JSON) [#example-request-json]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/export?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-19&format=json&groupBy=day&metrics=deliveries,opens,clicks" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response (JSON) [#example-response-json]

```json
{
  "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2026-03-19T23:59:59.999Z",
  "groupBy": "day",
  "data": [
    {
      "date": "2026-03-01",
      "deliveries": 520,
      "opens": 234,
      "clicks": 89
    },
    {
      "date": "2026-03-02",
      "deliveries": 480,
      "opens": 201,
      "clicks": 76
    }
  ]
}
```

### Example Request (CSV) [#example-request-csv]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/export?from=2026-03-01&format=csv&groupBy=day" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -o analytics.csv
```

The CSV response includes a `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="analytics-export.csv"` header. The first row contains column headers.

***

## Summary [#summary]

Get a high-level summary of your sending performance for a given period.

```
GET /analytics/summary
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters-4]

| Parameter | Type   | Default     | Description           |
| --------- | ------ | ----------- | --------------------- |
| `from`    | string | 30 days ago | Start date (ISO 8601) |
| `to`      | string | today       | End date (ISO 8601)   |

### Example Request [#example-request-3]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/analytics/summary?from=2026-03-01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-3]

```json
{
  "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "to": "2026-03-19T23:59:59.999Z",
  "totals": {
    "sent": 10692,
    "delivered": 10590,
    "bounced": 72,
    "deferred": 30,
    "opened": 4580,
    "uniqueOpens": 3210,
    "clicked": 1620,
    "uniqueClicks": 1140,
    "complained": 8,
    "unsubscribed": 15
  },
  "rates": {
    "deliveryRate": 99.0,
    "bounceRate": 0.7,
    "openRate": 42.8,
    "clickRate": 15.2,
    "clickToOpenRate": 35.5,
    "complaintRate": 0.07,
    "unsubscribeRate": 0.14
  },
  "quotaUsed": 10692,
  "quotaLimit": 50000,
  "quotaPercentage": 21.4
}
```

The `rates` object contains percentages. `clickToOpenRate` is clicks divided by opens (not by sends).

***

## Metric Definitions [#metric-definitions]

| Metric            | Definition                                                       |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sent`            | Total emails submitted to the delivery queue                     |
| `delivered`       | Emails accepted by the recipient mail server (2xx SMTP response) |
| `bounced`         | Emails permanently rejected (5xx SMTP response)                  |
| `deferred`        | Emails temporarily rejected; NorthRelay will retry automatically |
| `opened`          | Total open events (includes repeat opens by the same recipient)  |
| `uniqueOpens`     | Distinct recipients who opened at least once                     |
| `clicked`         | Total click events (includes repeat clicks)                      |
| `uniqueClicks`    | Distinct recipients who clicked at least once                    |
| `complained`      | Recipients who marked the email as spam                          |
| `unsubscribed`    | Recipients who clicked the unsubscribe link                      |
| `deliveryRate`    | `delivered / sent * 100`                                         |
| `bounceRate`      | `bounced / sent * 100`                                           |
| `openRate`        | `uniqueOpens / delivered * 100`                                  |
| `clickRate`       | `uniqueClicks / delivered * 100`                                 |
| `clickToOpenRate` | `uniqueClicks / uniqueOpens * 100`                               |
| `complaintRate`   | `complained / delivered * 100`                                   |
| `unsubscribeRate` | `unsubscribed / delivered * 100`                                 |


# Authentication



# Authentication [#authentication]

Most NorthRelay API requests require authentication; tracking and signed unsubscribe endpoints have separate public access rules. The primary API method is Bearer authentication using API keys. Inactive, revoked and expired keys are rejected. Use the narrowest scope supported by the endpoint and rotate keys after exposure.

API keys require an active, verified account and grant access to that account's supported tenant APIs. Administrative actions require a dashboard session with recent MFA; an administrator's personal API key does not grant administrative privileges. Signing out revokes the dashboard session, and password/security changes require a fresh sign-in.

## API Key Formats [#api-key-formats]

NorthRelay issues two types of API keys, distinguished by prefix:

| Prefix     | Environment            | Behavior                                            |
| ---------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `nr_live_` | Production             | Sends real emails                                   |
| `nr_test_` | Accepted legacy prefix | The prefix alone does not provide sandbox isolation |

Both prefixes use the same validator. A prefix alone does not prevent real delivery or quota consumption. Use an isolated test environment and a mail sink for integration tests.

## Creating an API Key [#creating-an-api-key]

1. Navigate to **Dashboard > Settings > API Keys**
2. Click **Create API Key**
3. Enter a descriptive name (e.g., "Production Backend", "Staging CI")
4. Select the key scope (see [Key Scopes](#key-scopes) below)
5. Click **Generate**
6. Copy the key immediately -- it is shown only once

The key is a long random string prefixed with `nr_live_` or `nr_test_`:

```
nr_live_sk_7f3a9b2c4d5e6f1a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f
```

## Using Your API Key [#using-your-api-key]

Include the key in the `Authorization` header as a Bearer token:

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "from": { "email": "hello@yourdomain.com", "name": "Your App" },
    "to": [{ "email": "user@example.com" }],
    "content": {
      "subject": "Welcome!",
      "text": "Thanks for signing up."
    }
  }'
```

### Node.js (fetch) [#nodejs-fetch]

```typescript
const response = await fetch("https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/send", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.NORTHRELAY_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    from: { email: "hello@yourdomain.com", name: "Your App" },
    to: [{ email: "user@example.com" }],
    content: {
      subject: "Welcome!",
      text: "Thanks for signing up.",
    },
  }),
});

const result = await response.json();
```

### Python (requests) [#python-requests]

```python
import os
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/send",
    headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['NORTHRELAY_API_KEY']}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    json={
        "from": {"email": "hello@yourdomain.com", "name": "Your App"},
        "to": [{"email": "user@example.com"}],
        "content": {
            "subject": "Welcome!",
            "text": "Thanks for signing up.",
        },
    },
)

result = response.json()
```

## Key Scopes [#key-scopes]

API keys can be scoped to limit their permissions:

| Scope                                     | Permissions                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `full_access`                             | All API operations (send, domains, templates, contacts, webhooks, analytics)                                   |
| `sending_access`                          | Convenience scope for `emails:send` and `emails:read`                                                          |
| `emails:send`, `emails:read`              | Send/manage submission jobs, or read email status and validate addresses                                       |
| `templates:read`, `templates:write`       | Read/preview templates, or manage templates and branding                                                       |
| `contacts:read`, `contacts:write`         | Read/export contacts and subscription status, or manage/import contacts, lists, subscriptions and signup forms |
| `domains:read`, `domains:write`           | Read domains, or manage/verify domains                                                                         |
| `campaigns:read`, `campaigns:write`       | Read campaigns, or manage campaigns; dispatch also requires `emails:send`                                      |
| `webhooks:read`, `webhooks:write`         | Read webhooks, or manage/retry webhook deliveries                                                              |
| `suppressions:read`, `suppressions:write` | Read or manage suppressions and preferences                                                                    |
| `analytics:read`, `keys:read`             | Read analytics or API key metadata                                                                             |

Select the narrowest scopes that meet your use case. `sending` and `read_only` are not recognized scope names. The dashboard sending preset additionally includes template/domain read scopes. API key creation, deletion and revocation require `full_access`; `keys:write` alone cannot mint broader credentials. Unclassified routes require `full_access` by default. Existing legacy keys with null/empty stored scopes retain full access for compatibility and should be reviewed explicitly.

## Keys Issued to Connectors (OAuth) [#keys-issued-to-connectors-oauth]

An MCP client that speaks OAuth rather than taking a key — the claude.ai and
Claude Desktop connectors — obtains one through the platform's authorization
server (`/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`). The client registers
itself, sends you to a NorthRelay sign-in page that names the client and
the address the token will go to, and you tick exactly the permissions it
gets, starting from read-only. What is approved is an ordinary API key named
`oauth-<client>-…`: it appears under **Settings → API Keys**, holds only the
scopes you ticked (never `full_access` or `keys:*`), cannot authenticate to
SMTP, expires after 30 days and is renewed by the client through a rotating
refresh token. Revoking it under API Keys ends the connector's access: the
next renewal is refused and the grant is closed. A refresh token presented
twice, or an authorization code presented twice, revokes the whole grant —
a stolen copy is indistinguishable from the real one until it is used
twice, and which holder is the thief is unknowable.

## Session Authentication [#session-authentication]

New passwords and password resets require at least 12 characters, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit, with a maximum of 72 UTF-8 bytes. Existing-account login remains compatible with previously accepted passwords.

Dashboard endpoints also accept NextAuth.js session cookies. This is used automatically when you interact with the API from the NorthRelay dashboard. Session auth is not recommended for server-to-server integrations -- use API keys instead.

## Error Responses [#error-responses]

Authentication failures return a `401` status:

```json
{
  "code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
  "message": "Authentication required",
  "action": "Sign in to your account or provide a valid API key.",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.northrelay.ca/api/authentication"
}
```

An invalid or revoked key returns:

```json
{
  "code": "API_KEY_INVALID",
  "message": "The provided API key is invalid or has been revoked",
  "action": "Generate a new API key in Dashboard > Settings > API Keys.",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.northrelay.ca/api-keys/troubleshooting"
}
```

## Security Best Practices [#security-best-practices]

1. **Never commit API keys to version control.** Store them in environment variables or a secrets manager.

2. **Use separate keys per environment.** Create distinct keys for production, staging, and development.

3. **Rotate keys regularly.** Revoke and regenerate keys every 90 days or after any suspected exposure.

4. **Use the narrowest scope.** A backend that only sends emails should use a `sending_access`- or `emails:send`-scoped key.

5. **Use `nr_test_` keys for development.** Avoid consuming production quota or accidentally sending real emails during testing.

6. **Restrict server-side only.** Never expose API keys in client-side JavaScript, mobile apps, or public repositories.

7. **Monitor key usage.** Review API key activity in Dashboard > Settings > API Keys to detect unauthorized use.

8. **Revoke compromised keys immediately.** If a key is leaked, revoke it in the dashboard and generate a replacement.


# Contacts API



# Contacts API [#contacts-api]

The Contacts API stores recipient information, organizes contacts into lists, and manages tags for targeted campaigns. Every route on this page works with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer nr_live_...`) as well as from the dashboard.

To subscribe someone with consent evidence and double opt-in, or to unsubscribe them, use the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions) instead of writing contact status directly: it applies the opt-out rules, records consent and fires the `contact.*` and `list.*` webhooks.

## Scopes [#scopes]

| Routes                                                        | Scope            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `GET` on any `/contacts/**` route, and `GET /contacts/export` | `contacts:read`  |
| `POST`, `PATCH`, `PUT`, `DELETE` on any `/contacts/**` route  | `contacts:write` |

## Response format [#response-format]

Contact routes (`/contacts`, `/contacts/{id}`, tags, bulk) use the standard envelope: `{ "success": true, "data": ... }` on success and `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "fix_action", "docs_url" } }` on failure. List routes (`/contacts/lists/**`) return `{ "data": ... }`; their newer member endpoints also include `success`. Import returns the result object directly.

***

## List Contacts [#list-contacts]

```
GET /contacts
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters]

| Parameter   | Type    | Default     | Description                                                    |
| ----------- | ------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `page`      | integer | `1`         | Page number                                                    |
| `limit`     | integer | `100`       | Items per page (max 1000)                                      |
| `status`    | string  | --          | `ACTIVE`, `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED` |
| `source`    | string  | --          | `MANUAL`, `CSV_IMPORT`, `API`, `FORM` or `SYNC`                |
| `tag`       | string  | --          | Only contacts with this tag                                    |
| `search`    | string  | --          | Matches email, first name or last name (case-insensitive)      |
| `sortBy`    | string  | `createdAt` | `createdAt`, `email` or `subscribedAt`                         |
| `sortOrder` | string  | `desc`      | `asc` or `desc`                                                |

To list the members of one list, use [`GET /contacts/lists/{id}/members`](#list-members).

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts?limit=10&search=alice" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
      "email": "alice@example.com",
      "firstName": "Alice",
      "lastName": "Johnson",
      "phone": null,
      "metadata": { "company": "Acme Inc" },
      "source": "API",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "subscribedAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "unsubscribedAt": null,
      "confirmedAt": null,
      "consentSource": "api",
      "consentAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-03T08:00:00.000Z",
      "tags": [{ "id": "cmg7tag0000001", "contactId": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc", "tag": "vip" }],
      "customFields": [{ "id": "cmg7cf00000001", "contactId": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc", "key": "plan", "value": "pro" }]
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "total_count": 1,
    "has_more": false
  }
}
```

The example is abridged: contacts also carry `userId`, `consentIp`, `consentUserAgent`, `consentText`, engagement fields and `confirmationFormId`.

***

## Get Contact [#get-contact]

```
GET /contacts/{id}
```

Returns the contact with its `tags` and `customFields`. Unknown ids and contacts of other accounts return `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

For a contact's lists, topics and consent evidence in one call, use [`GET /subscriptions/{email}`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#get-subscription-status).

***

## Create Contact [#create-contact]

```
POST /contacts
```

Rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client. For larger loads use [bulk create](#bulk-create) or [CSV import](#csv-import).

### Request Body [#request-body]

| Field          | Type      | Required | Description                                                                   |
| -------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`        | string    | Yes      | Contact email address (lowercased)                                            |
| `firstName`    | string    | No       | Max 100 characters                                                            |
| `lastName`     | string    | No       | Max 100 characters                                                            |
| `phone`        | string    | No       | E.164 format, for example `+15145551234`                                      |
| `metadata`     | object    | No       | Arbitrary JSON, max 4 KB                                                      |
| `source`       | string    | No       | `MANUAL`, `CSV_IMPORT`, `API`, `FORM` or `SYNC`. Defaults to `API`.           |
| `status`       | string    | No       | `ACTIVE` (default), `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`      |
| `tags`         | string\[] | No       | Up to 50 tags; lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`, max 50 characters each |
| `customFields` | object    | No       | String key/value pairs                                                        |

This route does not add the contact to lists, record consent evidence or fire webhooks. To do that in one call, use [`POST /subscriptions`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#subscribe).

### Example Request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "bob@example.com",
    "firstName": "Bob",
    "lastName": "Smith",
    "tags": ["eu-west", "trial"],
    "customFields": { "plan": "trial" },
    "metadata": { "company": "Example Corp" }
  }'
```

Returns `201` with the created contact (including `tags` and `customFields`) in `data`.

### Errors [#errors]

| Code                  | Status | Fix                                                                             |
| --------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`    | 400    | Correct the field named in `error.context.field`                                |
| `DUPLICATE_CONTACT`   | 409    | A contact with this email already exists. Update it with `PATCH /contacts/{id}` |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | 429    | Wait `error.context.retry_after` seconds                                        |

***

## Update Contact [#update-contact]

```
PATCH /contacts/{id}
```

Only the fields you send are changed. Accepts `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `phone`, `metadata`, `source` and `status`. Use the [tag routes](#tags) for tags.

Status changes must follow the allowed transitions:

| From                    | Allowed to                                         |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `PENDING`               | `ACTIVE`, `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `CLEANED`                |
| `ACTIVE`                | `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED`, `CLEANED` |
| `UNSUBSCRIBED`          | `ACTIVE`, `PENDING`                                |
| `BOUNCED`               | `ACTIVE`                                           |
| `COMPLAINED`, `CLEANED` | none (terminal)                                    |

An invalid transition returns `400 INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION`. Changing `status` here only updates the contact; it does not add or lift suppressions or fire webhooks. To unsubscribe or resubscribe someone, use the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions).

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "firstName": "Robert", "metadata": { "company": "Example Corp", "seats": 12 } }'
```

***

## Delete Contact [#delete-contact]

```
DELETE /contacts/{id}
```

Permanently deletes the contact, its tags, custom fields and list memberships. Suppressions are kept, so a deleted address that had unsubscribed stays suppressed.

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "message": "Contact deleted successfully" } }
```

***

## Tags [#tags]

### Add tags to a contact [#add-tags-to-a-contact]

```
POST /contacts/{id}/tags
```

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc/tags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "tags": ["vip", "beta-tester"] }'
```

`tags` takes 1–50 tags (lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`). Existing tags are kept. Returns the contact with its tags. A contact holds at most 50 tags; exceeding that returns `400 TAG_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`.

### Remove a tag from a contact [#remove-a-tag-from-a-contact]

```
DELETE /contacts/{id}/tags/{tag}
```

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc/tags/beta-tester \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### List all tags in your account [#list-all-tags-in-your-account]

```
GET /contacts/tags
```

Returns `{ "data": [{ "name", "count", "color", "definitionId" }] }` with the number of contacts carrying each tag.

***

## Bulk Create and Delete [#bulk-create-and-delete]

### Bulk create [#bulk-create]

```
POST /contacts/bulk
```

| Field            | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                           |
| ---------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contacts`       | object\[] | Yes      | 1–1,000 contacts, each with the [Create Contact](#create-contact) fields                              |
| `skipDuplicates` | boolean   | No       | Default `true`: existing emails are counted in `skipped`. With `false` they are reported in `errors`. |

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "contacts": [
      { "email": "one@example.com", "firstName": "One" },
      { "email": "two@example.com", "tags": ["trial"] }
    ]
  }'
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "created": 2, "skipped": 0, "errors": [] }
}
```

`errors` is a list of `{ "email", "error" }`. Bulk create does not update existing contacts or add list memberships.

### Bulk delete [#bulk-delete]

```
DELETE /contacts/bulk
```

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "contactIds": ["cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc", "cmg7c0n1t0004qz8kzzzz1111"] }'
```

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "deleted": 2, "requested": 2 } }
```

`contactIds` takes 1–1,000 ids. Ids that are not yours are ignored (`deleted` \< `requested`).

***

## CSV Import [#csv-import]

```
POST /contacts/import
```

Imports a CSV file using multipart form data. New addresses are created as `ACTIVE` contacts with source `CSV_IMPORT` and consent source `import`; existing addresses are counted in `skipped` and not updated.

| Field      | Type        | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`     | CSV file    | Yes      | `.csv`, up to 2 MiB and 1,000 data rows plus the header row                                                                                                                                  |
| `mappings` | JSON string | Yes      | Array of `{ "csvColumn": "<header>", "field": "email" \| "firstName" \| "lastName" \| "phone" \| "skip" }`. `csvColumn` must match a header exactly. Exactly one column must map to `email`. |
| `listId`   | string      | No       | Add every imported contact, and every existing contact found in the file, to this list                                                                                                       |
| `tags`     | string      | No       | Comma-separated tags applied to newly created contacts (up to 20)                                                                                                                            |

Headers must be unique. Quoted commas, escaped quotes and multiline fields are supported. Maximum 100 columns and 4,096 characters per field; multipart overhead is capped at 64 KiB. Split larger imports into separate requests.

### Example Request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/import \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -F "file=@subscribers.csv" \
  -F 'mappings=[{"csvColumn":"Email","field":"email"},{"csvColumn":"First Name","field":"firstName"},{"csvColumn":"Company","field":"skip"}]' \
  -F "listId=cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz" \
  -F "tags=imported-2026-10,newsletter"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-1]

```json
{
  "imported": 182,
  "skipped": 14,
  "addedToList": 196,
  "errors": ["Line 37: Invalid email format - jane@@example.com"]
}
```

| Field         | Description                                                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `imported`    | New contacts created                                                              |
| `skipped`     | Rows whose address already existed                                                |
| `addedToList` | Contacts (new or existing) added to `listId` by this import; `0` without `listId` |
| `errors`      | One message per rejected row                                                      |

### Errors [#errors-1]

Import errors use a simpler body, `{ "error": "<message>" }`:

| Status | When                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400    | No file, not a `.csv`, invalid `mappings`, no email mapping, mapped email column missing, duplicate headers, malformed CSV, or row/column/field limits exceeded |
| 404    | `listId` is not one of your lists                                                                                                                               |
| 413    | File over 2 MiB or request too large                                                                                                                            |

Importing never clears suppressions: an address that bounced, complained or unsubscribed stays suppressed, and campaigns skip it. Only import addresses that agreed to receive your mail; import does not fire `contact.subscribed` or `list.member_added` webhooks.

***

## Contact Lists [#contact-lists]

Lists are named audiences for campaigns. A list can be tagged with a topic (`suppressionGroupId`): recipients who opt out of that topic leave the list and are skipped when you send to it. See [Suppressions: topics](/docs/api-reference/suppressions#topics-suppression-groups).

### List all contact lists [#list-all-contact-lists]

```
GET /contacts/lists
```

| Parameter    | Type    | Default | Description                  |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------- |
| `page`       | integer | `1`     | Page number                  |
| `limit`      | integer | `20`    | Items per page (max 100)     |
| `type`       | string  | --      | `STATIC`, `DYNAMIC` or `ALL` |
| `isArchived` | boolean | `false` | Show archived lists instead  |
| `search`     | string  | --      | Matches name or description  |

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz",
      "name": "Monthly newsletter",
      "description": "Everyone who signed up on the website",
      "type": "STATIC",
      "contactCount": 1542,
      "isArchived": false,
      "createdAt": "2026-09-15T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-05T12:00:00.000Z",
      "lastSyncedAt": null
    }
  ],
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20, "total": 3, "totalPages": 1 }
}
```

`contactCount` counts current members (removed memberships are excluded).

### Create a contact list [#create-a-contact-list]

```
POST /contacts/lists
```

| Field                | Type           | Required | Description                                                     |
| -------------------- | -------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`               | string         | Yes      | 1–255 characters                                                |
| `description`        | string         | No       | Max 1,000 characters                                            |
| `type`               | string         | No       | `STATIC` (default) or `DYNAMIC`                                 |
| `segmentRules`       | object         | No       | Rules for a dynamic list                                        |
| `suppressionGroupId` | string \| null | No       | Topic this list belongs to                                      |
| `trackingEnabled`    | boolean        | No       | Open/click tracking for campaigns to this list (default `true`) |

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/lists \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "name": "Product updates", "suppressionGroupId": "cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr" }'
```

Returns `201` with `{ "data": { ...list } }`.

### Get a contact list [#get-a-contact-list]

```
GET /contacts/lists/{id}
```

Returns `{ "data": { ...list } }` including `suppressionGroup` (`{ id, name, publicLabel }` or `null`) and `_count.members`.

### Update a contact list [#update-a-contact-list]

```
PATCH /contacts/lists/{id}
```

Accepts `name`, `description`, `segmentRules`, `isArchived`, `suppressionGroupId` (set `null` to untag) and `trackingEnabled`.

### Archive a contact list [#archive-a-contact-list]

```
DELETE /contacts/lists/{id}
```

Archives the list (`isArchived: true`). Contacts and memberships are kept. Returns `{ "success": true }`.

***

## List Members [#list-members]

### List members [#list-members-1]

```
GET /contacts/lists/{id}/members
```

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Description                                            |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `page`    | integer | `1`     | Page number                                            |
| `limit`   | integer | `50`    | Items per page (max 100)                               |
| `filter`  | string  | `all`   | `all`, `active` (no suppression flags) or `suppressed` |

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmg7m3mb00005qz8k1a2b3c4d",
      "contactId": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
      "contact": {
        "id": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
        "email": "jane@example.com",
        "firstName": "Jane",
        "lastName": null,
        "status": "ACTIVE",
        "subscribedAt": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z",
        "createdAt": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z"
      },
      "addedAt": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z",
      "removedAt": null,
      "suppressionStatuses": []
    }
  ],
  "counts": { "total": 1543, "active": 1530, "suppressed": 13 },
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "total": 1543, "totalPages": 31 }
}
```

Campaigns go only to current members whose contact is not `PENDING`. `suppressionStatuses` lists every reason the member will not receive mail: `REMOVED_FROM_LIST` (unsubscribed from this list), `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED`, `CLEANED`, `MANUALLY_SUPPRESSED`, `CATEGORY_SUPPRESSED` (opted out of the list's topic).

### Add members [#add-members]

```
POST /contacts/lists/{id}/members
```

Add existing contacts by id and/or email. With `createMissing: true`, unknown emails are created as `ACTIVE` contacts (source `API`) first.

| Field           | Type      | Required                       | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | --------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contactIds`    | string\[] | One of `contactIds` / `emails` | Up to 1,000 contact ids                                                                                                                              |
| `emails`        | string\[] | One of `contactIds` / `emails` | Up to 1,000 addresses                                                                                                                                |
| `createMissing` | boolean   | No                             | Create contacts for unknown emails. Addresses that unsubscribed, bounced, complained or are blocked are not created; they are reported in `blocked`. |

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/lists/cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz/members \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "emails": ["jane@example.com", "new@example.com", "gone@example.com"], "createMissing": true }'
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "added": 2,
    "alreadyMembers": 0,
    "notFound": [],
    "blocked": [{ "email": "gone@example.com", "reason": "RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED" }]
  },
  "added": 2,
  "skipped": 0,
  "message": "Added 2 contacts to list"
}
```

| Field                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `data.added`                  | Contacts added (or restored after an earlier removal)                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `data.alreadyMembers`         | Contacts that were already current members                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `data.notFound`               | Ids not in your account, and unknown emails when `createMissing` is not set                                                                                                                                                                |
| `data.blocked`                | `{ email, reason }` for unknown emails that could not be created; `reason` is a [Subscriptions error code](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#errors) such as `RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED`, `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED` or `FREE_TIER_CONTACT_LIMIT` |
| `added`, `skipped`, `message` | Kept for older clients; `skipped` equals `data.alreadyMembers`                                                                                                                                                                             |

Existing contacts are added as they are; send-time suppression still skips any that unsubscribed, bounced or complained. A `list.member_added` webhook fires for each added member. A list that is not yours returns `404 LIST_NOT_FOUND`.

### Remove members [#remove-members]

```
DELETE /contacts/lists/{id}/members
```

Remove by body `{ "contactIds": [...], "emails": [...] }`, or a single member with `?contactId=` or `?email=`.

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/contacts/lists/cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz/members?email=jane%40example.com" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "removed": 1 } }
```

This is the list owner removing someone: the membership is deleted and a `list.member_removed` webhook fires (`source: "API"`). It is not an unsubscribe; the contact can be added again. To record that a recipient asked to leave, use [`POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#unsubscribe) with `scope: "list"`.

| Code               | Status | Fix                                                                                |
| ------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400    | Send `contactIds` or `emails`, or `?contactId=` / `?email=`                        |
| `NOT_A_MEMBER`     | 404    | None of the contacts is in the list. Check with `GET /contacts/lists/{id}/members` |
| `LIST_NOT_FOUND`   | 404    | Check the list id with `GET /contacts/lists`                                       |

### SDK [#sdk]

TypeScript (`@northrelay/sdk` 1.9.0):

```typescript
// Lists (tag a list with a topic via suppressionGroupId)
const { data: list } = await client.contacts.createList({ name: 'Product updates', suppressionGroupId: topicId });

// Members by email, creating unknown contacts
const added = await client.contacts.addListMembers(list.id, { emails: ['jane@example.com'], createMissing: true });
console.log(added.data.added, added.data.blocked);

// Mailable members only
const page = await client.contacts.getListMembers(list.id, { filter: 'active', limit: 100 });

// Owner removal (not an unsubscribe)
await client.contacts.removeListMembers(list.id, { emails: ['jane@example.com'] });

// CSV import into the list
const imported = await client.contacts.importCsv(csvText, {
  mappings: [{ csvColumn: 'Email', field: 'email' }],
  listId: list.id,
  tags: ['imported'],
});
```

Python (`northrelay` 1.9.0, async). List methods take `topic_id` for `suppressionGroupId`:

```python
lst = await client.contacts.create_list("Product updates", topic_id=topic_id)

added = await client.contacts.add_to_list(lst.id, emails=["jane@example.com"], create_missing=True)
print(added.added, added.already_members, added.blocked)

page = await client.contacts.list_members(lst.id, filter="active", limit=100)

await client.contacts.remove_from_list(lst.id, emails=["jane@example.com"])

imported = await client.contacts.import_csv(
    "subscribers.csv",
    mappings=[{"csvColumn": "Email", "field": "email"}],
    list_id=lst.id,
    tags=["imported"],
)
```

MCP tools: `list_contact_lists`, `get_contact_list`, `create_contact_list`, `update_contact_list`, `delete_contact_list`, `add_list_members`, `remove_list_members`, `list_list_members`.

***

## Contact Object Reference [#contact-object-reference]

| Field              | Type           | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------ | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`               | string         | Unique contact identifier                                                                 |
| `email`            | string         | Contact email address (lowercase)                                                         |
| `firstName`        | string \| null | First name                                                                                |
| `lastName`         | string \| null | Last name                                                                                 |
| `phone`            | string \| null | Phone number                                                                              |
| `metadata`         | object \| null | Arbitrary metadata                                                                        |
| `source`           | string         | `MANUAL`, `CSV_IMPORT`, `API`, `FORM` or `SYNC`                                           |
| `status`           | string         | `PENDING`, `ACTIVE`, `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`                 |
| `subscribedAt`     | string         | ISO 8601 time the contact (re)subscribed                                                  |
| `unsubscribedAt`   | string \| null | ISO 8601 time of the last global unsubscribe                                              |
| `confirmedAt`      | string \| null | ISO 8601 time a double opt-in was confirmed                                               |
| `consentSource`    | string \| null | How consent was obtained: `api`, `form` (signup form), `import`, `preference_center`, ... |
| `consentAt`        | string \| null | When consent was recorded                                                                 |
| `consentIp`        | string \| null | Subscriber IP (supplied by you, or the submitting browser for signup forms)               |
| `consentUserAgent` | string \| null | Subscriber user agent (as above)                                                          |
| `consentText`      | string \| null | Wording the subscriber agreed to; signup forms record `Signup form: <form name>`          |
| `tags`             | object\[]      | `{ id, contactId, tag }`                                                                  |
| `customFields`     | object\[]      | `{ id, contactId, key, value }`                                                           |
| `createdAt`        | string         | ISO 8601 creation timestamp                                                               |
| `updatedAt`        | string         | ISO 8601 last update timestamp                                                            |


# Domains API



# Domains API [#domains-api]

Custom sending domains let you send emails from your own domain (e.g., `hello@yourdomain.com`) instead of a NorthRelay system subdomain. Custom domains require proper DNS configuration for SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

**Tier requirement:** Custom domains are available on Starter ($5/mo) and above. The Free tier sends from a NorthRelay system subdomain only.

| Tier       | Custom Domain Limit |
| ---------- | ------------------- |
| Free       | 0                   |
| Starter    | 1                   |
| Micro      | 2                   |
| Pro        | 5                   |
| Scale      | 20                  |
| Enterprise | Unlimited           |

## List Domains [#list-domains]

Retrieve all domains associated with your account.

```
GET /domains
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters]

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Description                                       |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `page`    | integer | `1`     | Page number                                       |
| `limit`   | integer | `25`    | Items per page (max 100)                          |
| `status`  | string  | --      | Filter by status: `pending`, `verified`, `failed` |

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/domains \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "dom_a1b2c3d4",
      "hostname": "yourdomain.com",
      "status": "verified",
      "isInboxHosted": false,
      "dnsRecords": {
        "spf": { "status": "verified", "value": "v=spf1 include:_spf.north-pipe.ca -all" },
        "dkim": { "status": "verified", "selector": "default" },
        "dmarc": { "status": "verified", "value": "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@yourdomain.com" },
        "verification": { "status": "verified", "value": "northrelay-verify=dom_a1b2c3d4" }
      },
      "createdAt": "2026-03-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "verifiedAt": "2026-03-01T10:15:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 25,
    "total": 1,
    "totalPages": 1
  }
}
```

***

```
GET /domains/{id}
```

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/domains/dom_a1b2c3d4 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-1]

Returns the same domain object structure as the list endpoint.

## Add Domain [#add-domain]

Register a new custom sending domain. After adding, you must configure DNS records and call the [Verify Domain](#verify-domain) endpoint.

```
POST /domains
```

### Request Body [#request-body]

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description                          |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `hostname` | string | Yes      | Domain name (e.g., `yourdomain.com`) |

### Example Request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/domains \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "hostname": "yourdomain.com" }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-2]

```json
{
  "id": "dom_a1b2c3d4",
  "hostname": "yourdomain.com",
  "status": "pending",
  "dnsRecords": {
    "verification": {
      "type": "TXT",
      "host": "yourdomain.com",
      "value": "northrelay-verify=dom_a1b2c3d4",
      "status": "pending"
    },
    "spf": {
      "type": "TXT",
      "host": "yourdomain.com",
      "value": "v=spf1 include:_spf.north-pipe.ca -all",
      "status": "pending"
    },
    "dkim": {
      "type": "TXT",
      "host": "default._domainkey.yourdomain.com",
      "value": "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIIBIjANBgkq...",
      "status": "pending"
    },
    "dmarc": {
      "type": "TXT",
      "host": "_dmarc.yourdomain.com",
      "value": "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@yourdomain.com",
      "status": "pending"
    }
  },
  "createdAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z"
}
```

### Error: Domain Limit Reached [#error-domain-limit-reached]

```json
{
  "code": "API_KEY_LIMIT_REACHED",
  "message": "You have reached the maximum number of custom domains for your plan",
  "action": "Upgrade to a higher tier to add more domains.",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.northrelay.ca/api-keys/limits"
}
```

***

## DNS Record Requirements [#dns-record-requirements]

After adding a domain, configure these four DNS records at your DNS provider:

### 1. Verification TXT Record [#1-verification-txt-record]

Proves domain ownership. Required before any other records are checked.

| Field | Value                            |
| ----- | -------------------------------- |
| Type  | `TXT`                            |
| Host  | `yourdomain.com`                 |
| Value | `northrelay-verify=dom_a1b2c3d4` |
| TTL   | 300 (or lowest available)        |

### 2. SPF Record [#2-spf-record]

Authorizes NorthRelay relay IPs to send on your behalf.

| Field | Value                                    |
| ----- | ---------------------------------------- |
| Type  | `TXT`                                    |
| Host  | `yourdomain.com`                         |
| Value | `v=spf1 include:_spf.north-pipe.ca -all` |

If you have an existing SPF record, add `include:_spf.north-pipe.ca` before the `all` mechanism. Only one SPF record per domain is allowed.

### 3. DKIM Record [#3-dkim-record]

Enables cryptographic signing of outbound emails. The public key is provided when you add the domain.

| Field | Value                               |
| ----- | ----------------------------------- |
| Type  | `TXT`                               |
| Host  | `default._domainkey.yourdomain.com` |
| Value | Provided in the Add Domain response |

### 4. DMARC Record [#4-dmarc-record]

Tells receiving servers how to handle authentication failures.

| Field | Value                                                     |
| ----- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Type  | `TXT`                                                     |
| Host  | `_dmarc.yourdomain.com`                                   |
| Value | `v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@yourdomain.com` |

Replace `dmarc@yourdomain.com` with the address where you want to receive DMARC aggregate reports.

***

## Verify Domain [#verify-domain]

Trigger DNS verification for a domain. NorthRelay checks all four DNS records and updates their status.

```
POST /domains/{id}/verify
```

### Example Request [#example-request-3]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/domains/dom_a1b2c3d4/verify \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response (Success) [#example-response-success]

```json
{
  "id": "dom_a1b2c3d4",
  "hostname": "yourdomain.com",
  "status": "verified",
  "dnsRecords": {
    "verification": { "status": "verified" },
    "spf": { "status": "verified" },
    "dkim": { "status": "verified" },
    "dmarc": { "status": "verified" }
  },
  "verifiedAt": "2026-03-19T14:35:00.000Z"
}
```

### Example Response (Partial Failure) [#example-response-partial-failure]

```json
{
  "id": "dom_a1b2c3d4",
  "hostname": "yourdomain.com",
  "status": "pending",
  "dnsRecords": {
    "verification": { "status": "verified" },
    "spf": { "status": "verified" },
    "dkim": { "status": "pending" },
    "dmarc": { "status": "pending" }
  },
  "verifiedAt": null
}
```

The domain status remains `pending` until all four records pass verification. You can call this endpoint repeatedly as you configure records.

### Common Verification Errors [#common-verification-errors]

| Error Code                | Cause                              | Fix                                                               |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DNS_VERIFICATION_FAILED` | Verification TXT record not found  | Add the TXT record and wait for DNS propagation (up to 48 hours)  |
| `DNS_RECORD_MISSING`      | SPF, DKIM, or DMARC record missing | Add the missing record per the instructions above                 |
| `DNS_LOOKUP_ERROR`        | DNS query failed                   | Check that the domain resolves and your DNS provider is reachable |

***

## Delete Domain [#delete-domain]

Remove a custom domain. This immediately stops sending from that domain. Emails already queued may still be delivered.

```
DELETE /domains/{id}
```

### Example Request [#example-request-4]

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/domains/dom_a1b2c3d4 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response-3]

```json
{
  "id": "dom_a1b2c3d4",
  "deleted": true
}
```

***

## Domain Object Reference [#domain-object-reference]

| Field           | Type           | Description                                                |
| --------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | string         | Unique domain identifier                                   |
| `hostname`      | string         | Domain name                                                |
| `status`        | string         | `pending`, `verified`, or `failed`                         |
| `isInboxHosted` | boolean        | Whether catch-all inbox hosting is enabled                 |
| `dnsRecords`    | object         | Status of each DNS record (verification, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) |
| `createdAt`     | string         | ISO 8601 creation timestamp                                |
| `verifiedAt`    | string \| null | ISO 8601 verification timestamp                            |


# API Reference



# API Reference [#api-reference]

The NorthRelay API lets you send transactional and marketing emails, manage domains, templates, contacts, mailing-list subscriptions, suppressions, and retrieve analytics programmatically.

## Base URL [#base-url]

All API requests use the following base URL:

```
https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/
```

All requests must be made over HTTPS. Plain HTTP requests are rejected.

## Authentication [#authentication]

Authenticate every request with a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ ... }'
```

API keys use two prefixes:

| Prefix     | Environment            | Purpose                                                                            |
| ---------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `nr_live_` | Production             | Sends real emails                                                                  |
| `nr_test_` | Accepted legacy prefix | Does not itself isolate delivery or quota; use a test environment with a mail sink |

Create and manage keys in **Dashboard > Settings > API Keys**. See the [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication) page for full details.

## Rate Limits [#rate-limits]

Sending quotas are enforced per account based on your plan tier. They are expressed as recipients per calendar month and reset on the 1st:

| Tier    | Monthly Quota | Price (CAD) |
| ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| Free    | 3,000         | Free        |
| Starter | 5,000         | $5/mo       |
| Micro   | 20,000        | $12/mo      |
| Pro     | 50,000        | $29/mo      |
| Scale   | 150,000       | $79/mo      |

When you exceed your monthly quota, the API returns a `429` status with the `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` error code and the date the counter resets. Upgrading raises the limit immediately.

API request rate limits (separate from email quotas):

| Endpoint                | Limit               |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- |
| `POST /emails/send`     | 100 requests/second |
| `POST /emails/batch`    | 10 requests/second  |
| `POST /emails/validate` | 50 requests/second  |
| All other endpoints     | 200 requests/second |

## Error Handling [#error-handling]

Every error response follows a consistent JSON structure with four fields:

```json
{
  "code": "DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND",
  "message": "The specified domain was not found",
  "action": "Check the domain ID and try again",
  "docs_url": "https://docs.northrelay.ca/domains/setup"
}
```

| Field      | Type   | Description                                           |
| ---------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `code`     | string | Machine-readable error code for programmatic handling |
| `message`  | string | Human-readable description of the problem             |
| `action`   | string | Actionable instruction to resolve the issue           |
| `docs_url` | string | Link to relevant documentation                        |

### HTTP Status Codes [#http-status-codes]

| Status | Meaning                           |
| ------ | --------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Success                           |
| `201`  | Resource created                  |
| `400`  | Validation error or bad request   |
| `401`  | Missing or invalid authentication |
| `403`  | Insufficient permissions or tier  |
| `404`  | Resource not found                |
| `429`  | Rate limit exceeded               |
| `500`  | Internal server error             |
| `503`  | Service temporarily unavailable   |

### Error Codes Reference [#error-codes-reference]

| Code                        | HTTP Status | Description                                |
| --------------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `UNAUTHORIZED`              | 401         | No valid session or API key provided       |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`       | 401         | API key is malformed or revoked            |
| `SESSION_EXPIRED`           | 401         | Session token has expired                  |
| `VERIFICATION_FAILED`       | 400         | Verification code is invalid               |
| `VERIFICATION_EXPIRED`      | 400         | Verification code has expired              |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`       | 429         | Monthly quota or request rate exceeded     |
| `DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND`          | 404         | Domain ID does not exist                   |
| `DOMAIN_ALREADY_EXISTS`     | 400         | Domain is already registered               |
| `DNS_VERIFICATION_FAILED`   | 400         | Required DNS records not found             |
| `DNS_RECORD_MISSING`        | 400         | Specific DNS record is missing             |
| `DNS_LOOKUP_ERROR`          | 400         | Unable to query DNS for the domain         |
| `API_KEY_NOT_FOUND`         | 404         | API key ID does not exist                  |
| `API_KEY_INVALID`           | 401         | API key is invalid or expired              |
| `API_KEY_LIMIT_REACHED`     | 400         | Maximum number of API keys reached         |
| `WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID` | 401         | Webhook signature verification failed      |
| `WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_INVALID`   | 400         | Webhook payload does not match schema      |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_UNKNOWN`     | 400         | Unrecognized webhook event type            |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`          | 400         | Request body failed validation             |
| `NOT_FOUND`                 | 404         | Requested resource not found               |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR`            | 500         | Unexpected server error                    |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`       | 503         | Downstream service temporarily unavailable |

## Pagination [#pagination]

List endpoints return paginated results. Control pagination with query parameters:

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Description              |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| `page`    | integer | `1`     | Page number (1-indexed)  |
| `limit`   | integer | `25`    | Items per page (max 100) |

Every paginated response includes a `pagination` object:

```json
{
  "data": [ ... ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 25,
    "total": 142,
    "totalPages": 6
  }
}
```

## Versioning [#versioning]

The API is versioned via the URL path (`/api/v1/`). Breaking changes will be introduced under a new version prefix (e.g., `/api/v2/`). Non-breaking additions (new fields, new endpoints) are added to the current version without a version bump.

## Content Type [#content-type]

All request bodies must be JSON with the `Content-Type: application/json` header. All responses are JSON.

## Next Steps [#next-steps]

* [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication) -- create and use API keys
* [Sending](/api-reference/sending) -- send single, batch, and scheduled emails
* [Domains](/api-reference/domains) -- add and verify custom sending domains
* [Templates](/api-reference/templates) -- manage reusable email templates
* [Webhooks](/api-reference/webhooks) -- receive delivery event notifications
