# Sending API



# Sending API [#sending-api]

The Sending API provides four endpoints for email delivery and address validation. Contact support to confirm SMTP/IMAP availability for your account.

Each message supports at most **100 distinct recipients across To, CC and BCC**. Addresses are deduplicated before quota accounting. Quota reserves recipient attempts at acceptance; a downstream rejection does not automatically refund the reservation. Queued retries reuse the reservation. Account and platform daily limits also apply. Hard-bounced and complained recipients are excluded from every envelope field; marketing mail also honors opt-outs.

Sending requests are limited to 8 MiB of JSON; each HTML/text body is limited to 1 MiB. Ambiguous submission outcomes are held for review to prevent duplicate delivery. Check message status before submitting a replacement request.

## Send Email [#send-email]

Send a single email to one or more recipients.

```
POST /emails/send
```

### Request Body [#request-body]

| Field         | Type                             | Required | Description                                                                 |
| ------------- | -------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from`        | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)    | Yes      | Sender address                                                              |
| `to`          | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)\[] | Yes      | Recipients (1--100, shared total with CC/BCC)                               |
| `cc`          | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)\[] | No       | CC recipients                                                               |
| `bcc`         | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)\[] | No       | BCC recipients                                                              |
| `replyTo`     | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)    | No       | Reply-to address                                                            |
| `content`     | [Content](#content)              | Yes      | Email content (subject, body, or template)                                  |
| `variables`   | Record\<string, string>          | No       | Template variables for `{{variable}}` substitution                          |
| `themeId`     | string                           | No       | Theme ID for styled rendering                                               |
| `categories`  | string\[]                        | No       | Up to 10 categories (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores; max 64 chars each) |
| `tags`        | Record\<string, string>          | No       | Custom key-value tags for filtering in analytics                            |
| `metadata`    | Record\<string, any>             | No       | Arbitrary metadata returned in webhooks                                     |
| `attachments` | [Attachment](#attachment)\[]     | No       | File attachments                                                            |

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "from": { "email": "hello@yourdomain.com", "name": "Acme Inc" },
    "to": [
      { "email": "alice@example.com", "name": "Alice" }
    ],
    "replyTo": { "email": "support@yourdomain.com" },
    "content": {
      "subject": "Your order has shipped",
      "html": "<h1>Order #1234</h1><p>Your package is on the way.</p>",
      "text": "Order #1234 - Your package is on the way."
    },
    "categories": ["transactional", "order-updates"],
    "tags": { "order_id": "1234" },
    "metadata": { "internal_ref": "ship-batch-42" }
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "id": "msg_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
  "status": "queued",
  "from": "hello@yourdomain.com",
  "to": ["alice@example.com"],
  "subject": "Your order has shipped",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z"
}
```

***

## Batch Send [#batch-send]

Send personalized emails to up to 1,000 recipients in a single request. Each recipient can have unique variable substitutions.

```
POST /emails/batch
```

### Request Body [#request-body-1]

| Field        | Type                                 | Required | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `from`       | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)        | Yes      | Sender address (shared across all recipients)              |
| `recipients` | [BatchRecipient](#batchrecipient)\[] | Yes      | Recipients with per-recipient variables (1--1,000)         |
| `content`    | [Content](#content)                  | Yes      | Shared email content; `subject` is required (not optional) |
| `categories` | string\[]                            | No       | Up to 10 categories                                        |
| `tags`       | Record\<string, string>              | No       | Custom key-value tags                                      |
| `metadata`   | Record\<string, any>                 | No       | Arbitrary metadata                                         |

### BatchRecipient Object [#batchrecipient-object]

| Field       | Type                             | Required | Description                      |
| ----------- | -------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- |
| `to`        | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)    | Yes      | Recipient address                |
| `cc`        | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)\[] | No       | CC recipients for this message   |
| `bcc`       | [EmailAddress](#emailaddress)\[] | No       | BCC recipients for this message  |
| `variables` | Record\<string, string>          | No       | Per-recipient template variables |

### Example Request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/batch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "from": { "email": "hello@yourdomain.com", "name": "Acme Inc" },
    "recipients": [
      {
        "to": { "email": "alice@example.com", "name": "Alice" },
        "variables": { "first_name": "Alice", "plan": "Startup" }
      },
      {
        "to": { "email": "bob@example.com", "name": "Bob" },
        "variables": { "first_name": "Bob", "plan": "Scale" }
      }
    ],
    "content": {
      "subject": "Welcome to {{plan}}, {{first_name}}!",
      "html": "<h1>Hi {{first_name}}</h1><p>You are now on the {{plan}} plan.</p>"
    },
    "categories": ["onboarding"]
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-1]

```json
{
  "batchId": "batch_x1y2z3",
  "status": "queued",
  "totalRecipients": 2,
  "createdAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z"
}
```

***

## Schedule Email [#schedule-email]

Schedule an email for future delivery. The request body is identical to [Send Email](#send-email) with one additional required field.

```
POST /emails/schedule
```

### Additional Field [#additional-field]

| Field          | Type              | Required | Description                                            |
| -------------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `scheduledFor` | string (ISO 8601) | Yes      | Delivery time; must be in the future and within 1 year |

### Example Request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/schedule \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "from": { "email": "hello@yourdomain.com" },
    "to": [{ "email": "alice@example.com" }],
    "content": {
      "subject": "Your trial ends tomorrow",
      "html": "<p>Just a reminder that your trial expires on March 20.</p>"
    },
    "scheduledFor": "2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z"
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-2]

```json
{
  "id": "msg_s4c5h6e7d8",
  "status": "scheduled",
  "scheduledFor": "2026-03-20T09:00:00.000Z",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z"
}
```

### Cancelling a Scheduled Email [#cancelling-a-scheduled-email]

```
DELETE /emails/schedule/{id}
```

Cancel a scheduled email before it is sent. Returns `404` if the email has already been delivered.

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/schedule/msg_s4c5h6e7d8 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

***

## Validate Email [#validate-email]

Check whether an email address is deliverable without sending a message. Performs syntax validation, DNS MX lookup, and optionally SMTP handshake verification.

```
POST /emails/validate
```

### Request Body [#request-body-2]

| Field      | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                            |
| ---------- | ------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `email`    | string  | Yes      | --      | Email address to validate                              |
| `extended` | boolean | No       | `false` | Enable SMTP handshake check (slower but more accurate) |
| `timeout`  | integer | No       | `10000` | Timeout in milliseconds (1,000--60,000)                |

### Example Request [#example-request-3]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/emails/validate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "alice@example.com",
    "extended": true,
    "timeout": 15000
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-3]

```json
{
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "valid": true,
  "checks": {
    "syntax": true,
    "mxRecords": true,
    "smtpHandshake": true,
    "disposable": false,
    "roleAccount": false
  },
  "suggestion": null
}
```

When validation fails, the `suggestion` field may offer a corrected address (e.g., `"suggestion": "alice@gmail.com"` for a misspelled domain).

### Bulk Validate [#bulk-validate]

Validate up to 10,000 addresses in a single request.

```
POST /emails/validate/bulk
```

| Field             | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                          |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `emails`          | string\[] | Yes      | --      | Email addresses to validate (1--10,000)              |
| `extended`        | boolean   | No       | `false` | Enable SMTP handshake checks                         |
| `timeout`         | integer   | No       | `30000` | Timeout in milliseconds (1,000--60,000)              |
| `continueOnError` | boolean   | No       | `true`  | Continue validating remaining addresses if one fails |

***

## Shared Types [#shared-types]

### EmailAddress [#emailaddress]

| Field   | Type   | Required | Description         |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------- |
| `email` | string | Yes      | Valid email address |
| `name`  | string | No       | Display name        |

```json
{ "email": "alice@example.com", "name": "Alice Johnson" }
```

### Content [#content]

| Field         | Type                         | Required    | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subject`     | string                       | Conditional | Required unless `templateId` is provided (1--998 chars)                |
| `html`        | string                       | Conditional | HTML body; at least one of `html`, `text`, or `templateId` is required |
| `text`        | string                       | Conditional | Plain-text body                                                        |
| `templateId`  | string                       | Conditional | ID of a saved [template](/api-reference/templates)                     |
| `attachments` | [Attachment](#attachment)\[] | No          | File attachments                                                       |

### Attachment [#attachment]

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description                                    |
| ------------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `filename`    | string | Yes      | File name with extension (e.g., `invoice.pdf`) |
| `content`     | string | Yes      | Base64-encoded file content                    |
| `contentType` | string | Yes      | MIME type (e.g., `application/pdf`)            |

***

## Validation Rules Summary [#validation-rules-summary]

| Constraint                  | Value                                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Max recipients per send     | 1,000                                            |
| Max recipients per batch    | 1,000                                            |
| Max subject length          | 998 characters                                   |
| Max categories per email    | 10                                               |
| Category format             | Alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores; max 64 chars |
| Schedule window             | Must be in the future, within 1 year             |
| Max bulk validate addresses | 10,000                                           |
| Validate timeout range      | 1,000--60,000 ms                                 |


# Subscriptions API



# Subscriptions API [#subscriptions-api]

The Subscriptions API is the one place to change who receives which mail. Use it from your own application to build newsletter signups, a preference page inside your product, or server-side opt-outs. Every call applies the same rules as NorthRelay's hosted forms, unsubscribe links and preference centre, and fires the same [webhooks](/docs/api-reference/webhooks#contact-list-and-engagement-events).

For a walkthrough of how the pieces fit together, see the [Mailing Lists guide](/docs/guides/mailing-lists).

## Concepts [#concepts]

| Term                   | What it is                                                                                                                                                                           | Managed with                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **List**               | An audience you send campaigns to. A contact is either a member or not.                                                                                                              | [`/contacts/lists`](/docs/api-reference/contacts#contact-lists)                     |
| **Topic**              | A category of mail a recipient can opt out of (for example "Product updates"). Stored as a suppression group. A member row in a topic means the address **opted out** of that topic. | [`/suppression-groups`](/docs/api-reference/suppressions#topics-suppression-groups) |
| **Global unsubscribe** | The recipient wants no marketing mail at all. The contact status becomes `UNSUBSCRIBED` and an account-level suppression with reason `Unsubscribe` is added.                         | This API                                                                            |

Rules the API enforces for you:

* Subscribing to a topic means removing the recipient's opt-out for it. Opting out of a topic also removes the recipient from every list tagged with that topic.
* Unsubscribing from a list keeps the membership history (the membership is marked removed). Removing a member as the list owner deletes it (see [list members](/docs/api-reference/contacts#list-members)).
* Someone who unsubscribed is never re-added silently. You must pass `"resubscribe": true`, and you should only do so after fresh consent.
* Bounce, complaint and manual suppressions are never lifted by a subscribe call.
* Contacts with status `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED` cannot be resubscribed.

## Authentication and scopes [#authentication-and-scopes]

All endpoints in the first part of this page take an API key: `Authorization: Bearer nr_live_...`. Restricted keys need these scopes:

| Endpoint                                                                                                                                    | Scope            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `GET /subscriptions/{email}`                                                                                                                | `contacts:read`  |
| `POST /subscriptions`, `POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`, `PATCH /subscriptions/{email}`, `POST /subscriptions/{email}/resend-confirmation` | `contacts:write` |

A key without the scope receives `403 SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT`; a missing or invalid key receives `401`.

The public endpoints for unsubscribe pages you host yourself (`POST /unsubscribe`, `POST /unsubscribe/one-click`) take the signed token from the unsubscribe link instead of an API key. See [Unsubscribe links](#unsubscribe-links).

## Response format [#response-format]

Successful responses use the standard envelope:

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { } }
```

Errors include the fix:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED",
    "message": "jane@example.com has unsubscribed.",
    "fix_action": "The recipient unsubscribed. Pass \"resubscribe\": true only when they have given fresh consent (for example by submitting a form again), ideally with \"doubleOptIn\": true.",
    "docs_url": "https://docs.northrelay.ca/api-reference/subscriptions"
  }
}
```

Validation errors use code `VALIDATION_ERROR` and name the offending field in `error.context.field`.

***

## Subscribe [#subscribe]

Create or update a contact, add it to lists, opt it into topics and record consent. With `doubleOptIn: true` NorthRelay emails a confirmation link and the contact stays `PENDING` until the recipient clicks it.

```
POST /subscriptions
```

Returns `201` when the contact was created, `200` when it already existed. Repeating the same call is safe: nothing is added twice.

### Request body [#request-body]

Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field                    | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------ | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`                  | string    | Yes      | Recipient address. Trimmed and lowercased. Max 254 characters.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `firstName`              | string    | No       | Max 100 characters                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `lastName`               | string    | No       | Max 100 characters                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `phone`                  | string    | No       | Max 40 characters                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `listIds`                | string\[] | No       | Lists to add the contact to (max 50)                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `topicIds`               | string\[] | No       | Topics to opt the contact into, i.e. remove any opt-out (max 50)                                                                                                                                                |
| `tags`                   | string\[] | No       | Tags to add (max 50, each 1–50 characters)                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `customFields`           | object    | No       | String key/value pairs stored as custom fields (keys max 100, values max 1,000 characters)                                                                                                                      |
| `metadata`               | object    | No       | Arbitrary JSON stored on the contact (replaces existing metadata)                                                                                                                                               |
| `doubleOptIn`            | boolean   | No       | Send a confirmation email and keep the contact `PENDING` until confirmed. Ignored for a contact that is already `ACTIVE`.                                                                                       |
| `confirmationTemplateId` | string    | No       | One of your templates to use for the confirmation email. It can use `{{confirm_url}}`, `{{first_name}}`, `{{last_name}}` and `{{email}}`. Defaults to NorthRelay's confirmation template with your brand theme. |
| `redirectUrl`            | string    | No       | `https://` URL the recipient is sent to after confirming. Without it they see a NorthRelay confirmation page.                                                                                                   |
| `resubscribe`            | boolean   | No       | Required to re-add someone who previously unsubscribed. Only use it with fresh consent.                                                                                                                         |
| `consent`                | object    | No       | Consent evidence: `{ ip?, userAgent?, text? }`. See below.                                                                                                                                                      |

#### Consent evidence [#consent-evidence]

NorthRelay stores the consent source (`api` for this endpoint), the time, and whatever you pass in `consent`:

| Field               | Type   | Description                                                                                                           |
| ------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `consent.ip`        | string | The subscriber's IP address. Pass it from your server: NorthRelay only sees your server's address. Max 64 characters. |
| `consent.userAgent` | string | The subscriber's browser user agent. Max 1,024 characters.                                                            |
| `consent.text`      | string | The exact wording the subscriber agreed to (for example the checkbox label). Max 2,000 characters.                    |

Together these are the record of express consent that CASL (Canada) and GDPR (EU) expect you to be able to produce. Consent is recorded when the contact is created, when it is resubscribed, or when it had no consent record yet; a repeat subscribe does not overwrite earlier evidence. Read it back with [Get subscription status](#get-subscription-status).

### Example request [#example-request]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/subscriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "listIds": ["cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz"],
    "topicIds": ["cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr"],
    "doubleOptIn": true,
    "redirectUrl": "https://yourapp.com/newsletter/confirmed",
    "consent": {
      "ip": "203.0.113.24",
      "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 14_6)",
      "text": "Yes, send me the monthly newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time."
    }
  }'
```

### Example response (`201`) [#example-response-201]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "contactId": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "status": "PENDING",
    "created": true,
    "listIds": ["cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz"],
    "addedToListIds": ["cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz"],
    "topicIds": ["cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr"],
    "requiresConfirmation": true,
    "confirmationSent": true
  }
}
```

| Field                  | Description                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contactId`            | The contact's id                                                                                                                                                    |
| `status`               | `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING` while a double opt-in is outstanding                                                                                                         |
| `created`              | `true` when this call created the contact                                                                                                                           |
| `listIds`              | The lists you asked for                                                                                                                                             |
| `addedToListIds`       | The lists the contact was actually added to by this call (empty when it was already a member)                                                                       |
| `topicIds`             | The topics you asked for                                                                                                                                            |
| `requiresConfirmation` | `true` when a confirmation email is required before the contact becomes active                                                                                      |
| `confirmationSent`     | `true` when the confirmation email was sent. It is `false` if platform sending is temporarily paused; retry later with [Resend confirmation](#resend-confirmation). |

Webhooks: `contact.subscribed` (with `source: "API"`), plus one `list.member_added` per list in `addedToListIds`.

### Double opt-in flow [#double-opt-in-flow]

1. Your app calls `POST /subscriptions` with `doubleOptIn: true`. The contact is `PENDING`.
2. The recipient receives a confirmation email with a link to `https://app.northrelay.ca/c/<token>`. The link is valid for 7 days.
3. When they click it, the contact becomes `ACTIVE`, a `contact.confirmed` webhook fires, and the recipient is redirected to your `redirectUrl` (or shown a confirmation page).

List memberships and topic opt-ins are applied immediately, so the contact appears in the list, with status `PENDING`, as soon as you subscribe it. Campaigns skip `PENDING` contacts until they confirm.

### Errors [#errors]

| Code                      | Status | When                                                                                                                         | Fix                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`        | 400    | Missing or invalid field, unknown field, or a non-`https://` `redirectUrl`                                                   | Correct the field named in `error.context.field`                                                                                                                        |
| `FREE_TIER_CONTACT_LIMIT` | 403    | A Free account already holds 100 active contacts                                                                             | Upgrade at `/dashboard/settings/billing`                                                                                                                                |
| `LIST_NOT_FOUND`          | 404    | A `listIds` entry does not exist in your account                                                                             | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/contacts/lists`                                                                                                                          |
| `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`         | 404    | A `topicIds` entry does not exist in your account                                                                            | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/suppression-groups`                                                                                                                      |
| `RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED`  | 409    | The address unsubscribed (contact `UNSUBSCRIBED`, or an `Unsubscribe` or `Manual` suppression) and `resubscribe` was not set | Pass `"resubscribe": true` only with fresh consent, ideally with `"doubleOptIn": true`                                                                                  |
| `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`    | 409    | The address hard-bounced or complained, or you passed `resubscribe` for an address on your manual suppression list           | Cannot be overridden by this API. Remove the suppression with `DELETE /api/v1/suppressions/{email}` only if you have confirmed the address is valid and wants your mail |
| `CONTACT_BLOCKED`         | 409    | The contact's status is `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`                                                                            | Delete the contact and only re-add it with fresh, documented consent                                                                                                    |

### SDK [#sdk]

TypeScript (`@northrelay/sdk` 1.9.0). Methods return the response envelope, so the result is in `data`. Errors are thrown as `NorthRelayError` with `code` and `fixAction`; `isSubscriptionError(error, code?)` narrows them:

```typescript
import { NorthRelayClient, isSubscriptionError } from '@northrelay/sdk';

const client = new NorthRelayClient({ apiKey: process.env.NORTHRELAY_API_KEY! });

try {
  const { data } = await client.subscriptions.subscribe({
    email: 'jane@example.com',
    listIds: ['cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz'],
    doubleOptIn: true,
    redirectUrl: 'https://yourapp.com/newsletter/confirmed',
    consent: { ip: req.ip, userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'], text: CONSENT_TEXT },
  });
  console.log(data.status, data.confirmationSent); // 'PENDING', true
} catch (error) {
  if (isSubscriptionError(error, 'RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED')) {
    // ask for fresh consent, then retry with resubscribe: true
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

Python (`northrelay` 1.9.0, async). The email is positional, the rest are keyword arguments; the result is a `SubscribeResult` model with snake\_case attributes. A 409 raises `NorthRelayError` with the API code in `error.details["code"]`:

```python
import os
from northrelay import NorthRelay, NorthRelayError

client = NorthRelay(api_key=os.environ["NORTHRELAY_API_KEY"])

try:
    result = await client.subscriptions.subscribe(
        "jane@example.com",
        list_ids=["cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz"],
        double_opt_in=True,
        redirect_url="https://yourapp.com/newsletter/confirmed",
        consent={"ip": client_ip, "user_agent": user_agent, "text": CONSENT_TEXT},
    )
    print(result.status, result.confirmation_sent)  # PENDING True
except NorthRelayError as error:
    if error.details.get("code") == "RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED":
        ...  # ask for fresh consent, then retry with resubscribe=True
    else:
        raise
```

***

## Unsubscribe [#unsubscribe]

Opt an address out from your own server, for example when a user switches off a newsletter in your product's settings.

```
POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe
```

### Request body [#request-body-1]

| Field     | Type   | Required                | Description                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`   | string | Yes                     | Recipient address                                                                                  |
| `scope`   | string | No                      | `all` (default), `list` or `topic`                                                                 |
| `listId`  | string | When `scope` is `list`  | The list to leave                                                                                  |
| `topicId` | string | When `scope` is `topic` | The topic to opt out of                                                                            |
| `reason`  | string | No                      | Free text, max 500 characters. Stored on the contact for `scope: all` and included in the webhook. |

What each scope does:

| Scope   | Effect                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `all`   | Contact status becomes `UNSUBSCRIBED` and an account-level suppression with reason `Unsubscribe` is added. Works even when the address is not a contact. An existing `Bounce`, `Complaint` or `Manual` suppression is kept. |
| `list`  | The contact leaves that list and no longer receives campaigns sent to it. The membership is marked removed so the history stays visible. No effect when the address is not a contact.                                       |
| `topic` | The address is opted out of that topic and removed from every list tagged with it. Works even when the address is not a contact.                                                                                            |

### Example request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/subscriptions/unsubscribe \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "scope": "topic",
    "topicId": "cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr",
    "reason": "Turned off product updates in account settings"
  }'
```

### Example response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "contactId": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
    "scope": "topic",
    "changed": true
  }
}
```

`changed` is `false` when the address was already opted out, so the call is safe to repeat. `contactId` is `null` when the address is not a contact. A `contact.unsubscribed` webhook (with `method: "api"`) fires only when something changed, plus `list.member_removed` for each list the contact left.

### Errors [#errors-1]

| Code               | Status | When                                                                        | Fix                                                |
| ------------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400    | Invalid email, unknown field, or `listId` / `topicId` missing for its scope | Add the id that matches `scope`                    |
| `LIST_NOT_FOUND`   | 404    | `listId` is not in your account                                             | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/contacts/lists`     |
| `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`  | 404    | `topicId` is not in your account                                            | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/suppression-groups` |

### SDK [#sdk-1]

```typescript
const { data } = await client.subscriptions.unsubscribe({
  email: 'jane@example.com',
  scope: 'topic',
  topicId: 'cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr',
});
// data.changed === false when they had already opted out
```

```python
result = await client.subscriptions.unsubscribe(
    "jane@example.com", scope="topic", topic_id="cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr"
)
print(result.changed)
```

***

## Get subscription status [#get-subscription-status]

Everything you need to render a preference page: the contact and its consent evidence, any account-level suppression, a pending double opt-in, every list membership (current and past) and every topic with a `subscribed` flag.

```
GET /subscriptions/{email}
```

URL-encode the address once (`jane%2Bnews%40example.com` for `jane+news@example.com`); do not double-encode it. An address that is not a contact still returns `200` with `contact: null`, so you can show topic choices before someone subscribes.

### Example request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/subscriptions/jane%40example.com \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example response [#example-response-1]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "contact": {
      "id": "cmg7c0n1t0001qz8k2v5x9abc",
      "status": "ACTIVE",
      "firstName": "Jane",
      "lastName": null,
      "subscribedAt": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z",
      "unsubscribedAt": null,
      "confirmedAt": "2026-10-06T14:05:40.000Z",
      "consent": {
        "source": "api",
        "at": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z",
        "ip": "203.0.113.24",
        "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 14_6)",
        "text": "Yes, send me the monthly newsletter. I can unsubscribe at any time."
      }
    },
    "suppression": null,
    "unsubscribedFromAll": false,
    "pendingConfirmation": null,
    "lists": [
      {
        "id": "cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz",
        "name": "Monthly newsletter",
        "subscribed": true,
        "addedAt": "2026-10-06T14:02:11.000Z",
        "removedAt": null
      }
    ],
    "topics": [
      {
        "id": "cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr",
        "name": "product-updates",
        "label": "Product updates",
        "description": "New features and release notes, about twice a month.",
        "subscribed": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

| Field                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contact`             | `null` when the address is not a contact. `status` is one of `PENDING`, `ACTIVE`, `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED`, `CLEANED`.                                                                     |
| `contact.consent`     | Consent evidence: `source` (for example `api`, `form`, `import`, `preference_center`), `at`, `ip`, `userAgent`, `text`. Any of them may be `null`.                                                        |
| `suppression`         | Account-level suppression `{ reason, since }` (`reason` is `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual`), or `null`                                                                                   |
| `unsubscribedFromAll` | `true` when the contact is `UNSUBSCRIBED` or any account-level suppression exists. No marketing mail reaches the address.                                                                                 |
| `pendingConfirmation` | `{ expiresAt }` while a double opt-in is outstanding, else `null`                                                                                                                                         |
| `lists`               | Every list the contact has been a member of, newest first. `subscribed` is `false` (with `removedAt`) after an unsubscribe.                                                                               |
| `topics`              | Every topic in your account, ordered by `sortOrder` then name. `label` and `description` are the public wording you set on the topic (may be `null`). `subscribed` is `false` when the address opted out. |

`topics` includes topics you have not published on NorthRelay's hosted preference centre; filter them in your page if needed.

### Errors [#errors-2]

| Code               | Status | When                                  | Fix                         |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400    | The path is not a valid email address | URL-encode the address once |

### SDK [#sdk-2]

Both SDKs URL-encode the address for you.

```typescript
const { data: status } = await client.subscriptions.get('jane@example.com');
const optedOut = status.topics.filter((t) => !t.subscribed);
```

```python
status = await client.subscriptions.get("jane@example.com")
opted_out = [t for t in status.topics if not t.subscribed]
print(status.unsubscribed_from_all, status.contact.consent.text if status.contact else None)
```

***

## Update preferences [#update-preferences]

Apply the choices from your preference page in one call. Returns the updated status in the same shape as [Get subscription status](#get-subscription-status).

```
PATCH /subscriptions/{email}
```

### Request body [#request-body-2]

Provide at least one of `topics`, `lists` or `unsubscribeAll`. Unknown fields are rejected.

| Field            | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `topics`         | object  | `{ "<topicId>": true \| false }`. `true` removes the opt-out, `false` opts out (and leaves lists tagged with the topic).                                                       |
| `lists`          | object  | `{ "<listId>": true \| false }`. `true` joins the list (the address must already be a contact), `false` leaves it.                                                             |
| `unsubscribeAll` | boolean | `true` unsubscribes from everything. When set, `topics` and `lists` in the same request are ignored.                                                                           |
| `resubscribe`    | boolean | Required when joining a list for someone who unsubscribed from everything                                                                                                      |
| `consent`        | object  | `{ ip?, userAgent?, text? }`, recorded when the change re-subscribes the contact. When `resubscribe` is `true` and `consent` is omitted, the request's IP address is recorded. |

Notes:

* Turning a topic back on does not lift a global unsubscribe. To bring back someone who unsubscribed from everything, join a list with `resubscribe: true`, or call [Subscribe](#subscribe) with `resubscribe: true`.
* Changes fire `contact.subscribed`, `contact.unsubscribed`, `list.member_added` and `list.member_removed` webhooks with `method: "api"` or `source: "API"`.

### Example request [#example-request-3]

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/subscriptions/jane%40example.com \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "topics": { "cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr": false },
    "lists": { "cmg7l1st00002qz8kfe4w1xyz": true }
  }'
```

The response is the full status object shown under [Get subscription status](#get-subscription-status).

### Errors [#errors-3]

| Code                     | Status | When                                                                               | Fix                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`       | 400    | Invalid email, unknown field, or none of `topics`, `lists`, `unsubscribeAll`       | Send at least one of them                            |
| `LIST_NOT_FOUND`         | 404    | A list id is not in your account                                                   | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/contacts/lists`       |
| `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`        | 404    | A topic id is not in your account                                                  | Check the id with `GET /api/v1/suppression-groups`   |
| `CONTACT_NOT_FOUND`      | 404    | Joining a list for an address that is not a contact                                | Subscribe it first with `POST /api/v1/subscriptions` |
| `RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED` | 409    | Joining a list for someone who unsubscribed from everything, without `resubscribe` | Pass `"resubscribe": true` with fresh consent        |
| `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`   | 409    | Joining a list for an address that bounced, complained or is manually suppressed   | Cannot be overridden by this API                     |
| `CONTACT_BLOCKED`        | 409    | The contact is `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`                                           | Only re-add with fresh, documented consent           |

### SDK [#sdk-3]

```typescript
const { data: status } = await client.subscriptions.updatePreferences('jane@example.com', {
  topics: { cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr: false },
});
```

```python
status = await client.subscriptions.update_preferences(
    "jane@example.com",
    topics={"cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr": False},
)
```

Python takes `unsubscribe_all=True` for `unsubscribeAll` and raises `ValueError` before calling the API when none of `topics`, `lists` or `unsubscribe_all` is given.

***

## Resend confirmation [#resend-confirmation]

Send the double opt-in email again for a `PENDING` contact that was subscribed through this API, and move the link's expiry to 7 days from now.

```
POST /subscriptions/{email}/resend-confirmation
```

No request body.

### Example request [#example-request-4]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/subscriptions/jane%40example.com/resend-confirmation \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example response [#example-response-2]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "email": "jane@example.com",
    "confirmationSent": true,
    "expiresAt": "2026-10-13T15:10:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### Errors [#errors-4]

| Code                      | Status | When                                                                                        | Fix                                                                      |
| ------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`        | 400    | The path is not a valid email address                                                       | URL-encode the address once                                              |
| `CONTACT_NOT_FOUND`       | 404    | The address is not a contact                                                                | Subscribe it first with `POST /api/v1/subscriptions`                     |
| `NO_PENDING_CONFIRMATION` | 409    | The contact is not `PENDING`, is already confirmed, or was subscribed through a signup form | Subscribe it again with `"doubleOptIn": true` to send a new confirmation |

### SDK [#sdk-4]

```typescript
const { data } = await client.subscriptions.resendConfirmation('jane@example.com');
console.log(data.expiresAt);
```

```python
result = await client.subscriptions.resend_confirmation("jane@example.com")
print(result.expires_at)
```

Neither SDK retries `subscribe` or `resendConfirmation` automatically, because a retry could send a second confirmation email.

***

## Unsubscribe links [#unsubscribe-links]

Marketing mail from NorthRelay carries a signed, per-recipient unsubscribe token:

* Campaign mail: the `{{unsubscribe_url}}` template variable, plus `List-Unsubscribe` and `List-Unsubscribe-Post` headers ([RFC 8058](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8058)).
* API mail on a marketing message stream: NorthRelay injects the unsubscribe footer and the same headers automatically.

The unsubscribe link has the form `https://track.north-pipe.ca/u/{token}`. The token identifies your account and the recipient, so the endpoints below need no API key. Unsubscribes from API mail are attributed to your account and fire `contact.unsubscribed` even when the recipient is not one of your contacts.

Campaign templates can also use `{{preferences_url}}`, a signed link to NorthRelay's hosted preference centre where the recipient can choose topics or unsubscribe from everything.

### Process an unsubscribe from your own page [#process-an-unsubscribe-from-your-own-page]

If you host your own unsubscribe landing page, send the token and the recipient's choice here. This endpoint is public; the token is the authentication.

```
POST /unsubscribe
```

| Field     | Type   | Required                | Description                                                                                                          |
| --------- | ------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `token`   | string | Yes                     | The token from the unsubscribe link                                                                                  |
| `scope`   | string | No                      | `all` (default), `list` or `topic`. `category` is accepted as a legacy alias of `topic`, and upper case is accepted. |
| `listId`  | string | When `scope` is `list`  | The list to leave                                                                                                    |
| `topicId` | string | When `scope` is `topic` | The topic to opt out of (legacy name: `suppressionGroupId`)                                                          |
| `reason`  | string | No                      | Max 500 characters                                                                                                   |

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/unsubscribe \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "token": "<token from the unsubscribe link>", "scope": "all" }'
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Successfully unsubscribed from all marketing emails",
  "data": { "scope": "all", "changed": true }
}
```

| Code                                 | Status | When                                                                         | Fix                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR`                   | 400    | `token` missing, body invalid, or `listId` / `topicId` missing for its scope | Send `{ "token": "...", "scope": "all" \| "list" \| "topic" }` with the matching id |
| `INVALID_TOKEN`                      | 400    | The token is forged, malformed or cannot be matched to a recipient           | Use the unsubscribe link from the most recent email                                 |
| `LIST_NOT_FOUND` / `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND` | 404    | The id is not in the sender's account                                        | Pass an id from the sender's account                                                |

A bare `contactId` is no longer accepted: it let anyone who learned a contact id opt that person out. For opt-outs from your own server use [`POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`](#unsubscribe) with your API key.

### One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058) [#one-click-unsubscribe-rfc-8058]

```
POST /unsubscribe/one-click?token={token}
```

Mailbox providers (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook) call the one-click URL from the `List-Unsubscribe` header when the recipient presses their built-in "Unsubscribe" button; NorthRelay's tracking service forwards those requests here. It unsubscribes the recipient from all marketing mail (webhook `method: "one_click"`) and always answers `200`, as RFC 8058 requires, even when the token cannot be resolved. A missing `token` returns `400`.

`GET /unsubscribe/one-click?token=` does **not** unsubscribe. Link scanners and security gateways prefetch URLs, so a GET redirects (`303`) to the confirmation page, where the recipient presses a button.

***

## Related [#related]

* [Mailing Lists guide](/docs/guides/mailing-lists): build signup, double opt-in and a preference page end to end
* [Contacts API](/docs/api-reference/contacts): contacts, lists, members, CSV import
* [Suppressions API](/docs/api-reference/suppressions): topics (suppression groups) and account-level suppressions
* [Webhooks](/docs/api-reference/webhooks): `contact.*`, `list.*`, `email.opened`, `email.clicked`


# Suppressions API



# Suppressions API [#suppressions-api]

Suppressions stop mail to addresses that should not receive it. NorthRelay has two layers:

* **Account-level suppressions** block an address for your whole account. NorthRelay adds them automatically on hard bounces, spam complaints and "unsubscribe from all"; you can also add them yourself.
* **Topics** (stored as suppression groups) let a recipient opt out of one category of mail, such as "Product updates", while still receiving the rest.

To subscribe or unsubscribe a recipient with the right side effects (contact status, list membership, webhooks), use the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions). The routes on this page manage the underlying records directly.

**Scopes:** `suppressions:read` for `GET`, `suppressions:write` for everything else, on both `/suppressions/**` and `/suppression-groups/**`.

## How suppressions apply when you send [#how-suppressions-apply-when-you-send]

NorthRelay filters every recipient before the message is queued. Filtered recipients are dropped and do not count against your monthly quota.

| Mail                                             | Blocked by                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Marketing (campaigns, marketing message streams) | Any account-level suppression; contact status `UNSUBSCRIBED`, `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`; an opt-out of the topic the message is sent under       |
| Transactional                                    | Only `Bounce` and `Complaint` suppressions and contact status `BOUNCED`, `COMPLAINED` or `CLEANED`. Unsubscribes do not block receipts and password resets. |

Suppression reasons:

| `reason`      | Added when                                                                           | Lifted by a subscribe call?     |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| `Bounce`      | Hard bounce (5xx) reported by the receiving server                                   | Never                           |
| `Complaint`   | Spam complaint via a feedback loop                                                   | Never                           |
| `Unsubscribe` | The recipient unsubscribed from all mail (link, one-click, preference centre or API) | Only with `"resubscribe": true` |
| `Manual`      | You added it                                                                         | Never; delete it yourself       |

***

## List Suppressions [#list-suppressions]

```
GET /suppressions
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters]

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Description                                      |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `page`    | integer | `1`     | Page number                                      |
| `limit`   | integer | `25`    | Items per page (max 100)                         |
| `reason`  | string  | --      | `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual` |
| `search`  | string  | --      | Matches part of the email address                |

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl "https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/suppressions?reason=Bounce&limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmg7s0p00001qz8kab12cd34",
      "email": "invalid@example.com",
      "reason": "Bounce",
      "details": {
        "bounceCode": "550",
        "bounceReason": "5.1.1 The email account that you tried to reach does not exist",
        "messageId": "<20261003081500.a1b2c3@yourdomain.com>",
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-03T08:15:00.000Z"
      },
      "createdAt": "2026-10-03T08:15:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 10, "total_count": 24, "has_more": true }
}
```

`details` is free-form and depends on how the suppression was created (for unsubscribes it records the `method` and `campaignId`).

***

## Get a Suppression [#get-a-suppression]

```
GET /suppressions/{email}
```

Returns the suppression for one address, or `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` when the address is not suppressed. URL-encode the address. To see suppression, contact status, lists and topics together, use [`GET /subscriptions/{email}`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#get-subscription-status).

***

## Add Suppression [#add-suppression]

```
POST /suppressions
```

### Request Body [#request-body]

| Field     | Type   | Required | Description                                          |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `email`   | string | Yes      | Email address to suppress                            |
| `reason`  | string | Yes      | `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual`     |
| `details` | object | No       | Free-form notes, for example a support ticket number |

If the address is already suppressed, its reason and details are updated.

### Example Request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/suppressions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "optout@example.com",
    "reason": "Manual",
    "details": { "ticket": "4521" }
  }'
```

Returns `201` with the suppression in `data`.

Adding an `Unsubscribe` suppression here does not change the contact's status or fire a webhook. To record an opt-out, prefer [`POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#unsubscribe).

***

## Bulk Add or Remove [#bulk-add-or-remove]

```
POST /suppressions/bulk
```

API key only.

| Field    | Type      | Required               | Description                                      |
| -------- | --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `action` | string    | Yes                    | `add` or `remove`                                |
| `emails` | string\[] | Yes                    | 1–10,000 addresses                               |
| `reason` | string    | When `action` is `add` | `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual` |

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/suppressions/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "action": "add",
    "reason": "Bounce",
    "emails": ["bounce1@example.com", "bounce2@example.com"]
  }'
```

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "action": "add", "requested": 2, "added": 2, "updated": 0 } }
```

`updated` counts addresses that were already suppressed with a different reason. With `action: "remove"` the response is `{ action, requested, removed }`.

***

## Remove Suppression [#remove-suppression]

```
DELETE /suppressions/{email}
```

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/suppressions/invalid%40example.com \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

```json
{ "success": true, "data": { "email": "invalid@example.com", "removed": true } }
```

Only remove a `Bounce` or `Complaint` suppression when you have confirmed the address is valid and wants your mail. Sending to addresses that bounced or complained damages your sender reputation and the shared sending IP.

***

## Topics (Suppression Groups) [#topics-suppression-groups]

A topic is a category of mail that recipients can opt out of on its own. Each topic is a suppression group, and **a member of the group is an address that opted out of that topic**. "Subscribing" someone to a topic means removing them from the group.

Topics take effect on marketing mail when you send:

* a campaign with a subscription topic set,
* a campaign to a list that is tagged with the topic (`suppressionGroupId` on the [list](/docs/api-reference/contacts#contact-lists)),
* a marketing-stream API message with `"suppressionGroupId": "<topicId>"` on the [send request](/docs/api-reference/sending).

Recipients who opted out of the topic are skipped. Transactional mail ignores topic opt-outs. Recipients can manage published topics themselves on NorthRelay's hosted preference centre (`{{preferences_url}}`), or on your own page through [`GET` / `PATCH /subscriptions/{email}`](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions#update-preferences).

Prefer the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions) for opt-ins and opt-outs: `POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe` with `scope: "topic"` also removes the recipient from lists tagged with the topic and fires `contact.unsubscribed`. The member routes below only edit the group.

### List topics [#list-topics]

```
GET /suppression-groups
```

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Description                                                                        |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `page`      | integer | `1`     | Page number                                                                        |
| `limit`     | integer | `25`    | Items per page (max 100)                                                           |
| `published` | boolean | --      | `true` returns only topics shown on the hosted preference centre, in display order |

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmg7t0p1c0003qz8k7h2d4pqr",
      "name": "product-updates",
      "description": "Release notes and feature announcements",
      "isDefault": false,
      "publicLabel": "Product updates",
      "publicDescription": "New features and release notes, about twice a month.",
      "isPublishedOnUnsub": true,
      "sortOrder": 0,
      "createdAt": "2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-09-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "_count": { "members": 12 }
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 25, "total_count": 1, "has_more": false }
}
```

`_count.members` is the number of addresses that opted out.

### Create a topic [#create-a-topic]

```
POST /suppression-groups
```

| Field         | Type    | Required | Description                              |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `name`        | string  | Yes      | 1–100 characters, unique in your account |
| `description` | string  | No       | Internal description, max 500 characters |
| `isDefault`   | boolean | No       | Mark as the default topic                |

### Get, update or delete a topic [#get-update-or-delete-a-topic]

```
GET    /suppression-groups/{id}
PATCH  /suppression-groups/{id}
DELETE /suppression-groups/{id}
```

`PATCH` accepts `name`, `description`, `isDefault`, and the public fields recipients see:

| Field                | Type           | Description                                                   |
| -------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `publicLabel`        | string \| null | Name shown to recipients (max 120 characters)                 |
| `publicDescription`  | string \| null | One-line explanation shown to recipients (max 500 characters) |
| `isPublishedOnUnsub` | boolean        | Show the topic on the hosted preference centre                |
| `sortOrder`          | integer        | Display order (0–10000)                                       |

Deleting a topic deletes its opt-outs; those addresses become eligible for that mail again.

### Topic opt-outs (members) [#topic-opt-outs-members]

```
GET    /suppression-groups/{id}/members
POST   /suppression-groups/{id}/members          { "email": "jane@example.com" }
DELETE /suppression-groups/{id}/members/{email}
```

`GET` returns `{ email, createdAt }` rows (paginated with `page` and `limit`). `POST` opts an address out (idempotent, returns `201`). `DELETE` removes the opt-out. The older paths `/suppression-groups/{id}/suppressions`, `/suppressions/{email}` and `/suppressions/bulk` remain available.

***

## Suppression Object Reference [#suppression-object-reference]

| Field       | Type           | Description                                      |
| ----------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`        | string         | Unique suppression identifier                    |
| `email`     | string         | Suppressed email address                         |
| `reason`    | string         | `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual` |
| `details`   | object \| null | Free-form details                                |
| `createdAt` | string         | ISO 8601 creation timestamp                      |


# Templates API



# Templates API [#templates-api]

Templates let you define reusable email layouts with dynamic variables. Use Handlebars-style `{{variable}}` syntax for personalization. Templates can be referenced by ID when sending emails, keeping your sending code clean and your email content centrally managed.

Template import/render requests accept at most 8 MiB of JSON. Imported HTML/text fields and MJML source are limited to 1 MiB each; MJML compilation requests allow 2 MiB of JSON for encoding overhead. Imports accept up to 100 templates with up to 500 blocks each. MJML file includes are disabled. Read/preview operations require `templates:read`; imports and changes require `templates:write`. Oversized request bodies return HTTP 413.

MJML compilation has a five-second deadline and 4 MiB output limit. If the compiler is busy, retry shortly; reduce large templates if they exceed resource limits.

## List Templates [#list-templates]

Retrieve all templates for your account.

```
GET /templates
```

### Query Parameters [#query-parameters]

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Description              |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| `page`    | integer | `1`     | Page number              |
| `limit`   | integer | `25`    | Items per page (max 100) |
| `search`  | string  | --      | Search by template name  |

### Example Request [#example-request]

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

### Example Response [#example-response]

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "tmpl_a1b2c3d4",
      "name": "Welcome Email",
      "subject": "Welcome to {{company_name}}, {{first_name}}!",
      "html": "<h1>Welcome, {{first_name}}</h1><p>Thanks for joining {{company_name}}.</p>",
      "text": "Welcome, {{first_name}}! Thanks for joining {{company_name}}.",
      "variables": ["first_name", "company_name"],
      "themeId": "theme_x1y2z3",
      "createdAt": "2026-03-01T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-03-15T08:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 25,
    "total": 12,
    "totalPages": 1
  }
}
```

***

## Get Template [#get-template]

Retrieve a single template by ID.

```
GET /templates/{id}
```

### Example Request [#example-request-1]

```bash
curl https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates/tmpl_a1b2c3d4 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

***

## Create Template [#create-template]

Create a new email template.

```
POST /templates
```

### Request Body [#request-body]

| Field     | Type   | Required    | Description                                               |
| --------- | ------ | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`    | string | Yes         | Template name (for internal reference)                    |
| `subject` | string | Yes         | Subject line; supports `{{variable}}` syntax              |
| `html`    | string | Conditional | HTML body; at least one of `html` or `text` is required   |
| `text`    | string | Conditional | Plain-text body                                           |
| `themeId` | string | No          | Theme ID for consistent branding (header, footer, colors) |

### Example Request [#example-request-2]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Order Confirmation",
    "subject": "Order #{{order_id}} confirmed",
    "html": "<h1>Thank you, {{first_name}}!</h1><p>Your order #{{order_id}} has been confirmed.</p><p>Total: {{total}}</p>",
    "text": "Thank you, {{first_name}}! Your order #{{order_id}} has been confirmed. Total: {{total}}"
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-1]

```json
{
  "id": "tmpl_e5f6g7h8",
  "name": "Order Confirmation",
  "subject": "Order #{{order_id}} confirmed",
  "html": "<h1>Thank you, {{first_name}}!</h1><p>Your order #{{order_id}} has been confirmed.</p><p>Total: {{total}}</p>",
  "text": "Thank you, {{first_name}}! Your order #{{order_id}} has been confirmed. Total: {{total}}",
  "variables": ["order_id", "first_name", "total"],
  "themeId": null,
  "createdAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-03-19T14:30:00.000Z"
}
```

The `variables` array is automatically extracted from `{{variable}}` placeholders in the subject, html, and text fields.

***

## Update Template [#update-template]

Update an existing template. Only the fields you include are changed.

```
PUT /templates/{id}
```

### Request Body [#request-body-1]

| Field     | Type           | Required | Description                             |
| --------- | -------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `name`    | string         | No       | Updated template name                   |
| `subject` | string         | No       | Updated subject line                    |
| `html`    | string         | No       | Updated HTML body                       |
| `text`    | string         | No       | Updated plain-text body                 |
| `themeId` | string \| null | No       | Updated theme ID; pass `null` to remove |

### Example Request [#example-request-3]

```bash
curl -X PUT https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates/tmpl_e5f6g7h8 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "subject": "Order #{{order_id}} confirmed - {{company_name}}",
    "themeId": "theme_x1y2z3"
  }'
```

***

```

```

```bash
curl -X DELETE https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates/tmpl_e5f6g7h8 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
```

```json
{
  "id": "tmpl_e5f6g7h8",
  "deleted": true
}
```

## Preview / Render Template [#preview--render-template]

Render a template with sample variables without sending an email. Useful for previewing in your application or generating HTML for approval workflows.

```
POST /templates/{id}/render
```

### Request Body [#request-body-2]

| Field       | Type                    | Required | Description                   |
| ----------- | ----------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `variables` | Record\<string, string> | No       | Variable values to substitute |

### Example Request [#example-request-5]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates/tmpl_e5f6g7h8/render \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "variables": {
      "first_name": "Alice",
      "order_id": "1234",
      "total": "$49.99"
    }
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-3]

```json
{
  "subject": "Order #1234 confirmed",
  "html": "<h1>Thank you, Alice!</h1><p>Your order #1234 has been confirmed.</p><p>Total: $49.99</p>",
  "text": "Thank you, Alice! Your order #1234 has been confirmed. Total: $49.99"
}
```

Unresolved variables remain as literal `{{variable_name}}` in the output.

***

## Test Send [#test-send]

Send a rendered template to a test address. This counts against your monthly quota.

```
POST /templates/{id}/test
```

### Request Body [#request-body-3]

| Field       | Type                                                | Required | Description                          |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `to`        | string                                              | Yes      | Recipient email address for the test |
| `from`      | [EmailAddress](/api-reference/sending#emailaddress) | Yes      | Sender address                       |
| `variables` | Record\<string, string>                             | No       | Variable values to substitute        |

### Example Request [#example-request-6]

```bash
curl -X POST https://app.northrelay.ca/api/v1/templates/tmpl_e5f6g7h8/test \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "test@yourdomain.com",
    "from": { "email": "hello@yourdomain.com", "name": "Acme Inc" },
    "variables": {
      "first_name": "Test User",
      "order_id": "0000",
      "total": "$0.00"
    }
  }'
```

### Example Response [#example-response-4]

```json
{
  "id": "msg_t1e2s3t4",
  "status": "queued",
  "templateId": "tmpl_e5f6g7h8"
}
```
