The contact, subscription, topic and form tools return structured content and carry MCP annotations (read-only, destructive, idempotent). Their errors keep the API `code`, `status` and `fix_action`.

## Usage Examples [#usage-examples]

Once configured, interact with NorthRelay through natural language in your AI client.

### Sending Emails [#sending-emails]

> "Send a welcome email to [jane@example.com](mailto:jane@example.com) with the subject 'Welcome to our platform' and an HTML body with a greeting."

The AI agent will call `send_email` with the appropriate parameters.

### Managing Templates [#managing-templates]

> "Create a new email template called 'Password Reset' with a subject line 'Reset your password' and a body that includes a reset link placeholder."

> "List all my email templates."

> "Delete the template called 'Old Newsletter'."

### Checking Delivery Status [#checking-delivery-status]

> "What's the delivery status of the last 10 emails I sent?"

> "Show me the delivery analytics for March 2026."

### Deliverability Checks [#deliverability-checks]

> "Check the DNS records and blocklist status for mail.mycompany.com."

The agent calls `check_dns` and `check_blocklist`.

### Campaign Management [#campaign-management]

> "Create a campaign called 'Spring Sale' using my 'promotion' template, targeting my 'active-customers' contact list, scheduled for March 25th at 10am UTC."

> "Show me the details of my 'Spring Sale' campaign." (`get_campaign`)

### Mailing Lists and Subscriptions [#mailing-lists-and-subscriptions]

> "Subscribe [jane@example.com](mailto:jane@example.com) to my 'Monthly newsletter' list with double opt-in, and record that she ticked 'Send me the monthly newsletter'."

The agent calls `subscribe_contact` with `doubleOptIn` and the consent text. Jane stays pending until she clicks the confirmation link.

> "Is [bob@example.com](mailto:bob@example.com) still subscribed? Which topics has he opted out of?"

The agent calls `get_subscription_status`, which returns his lists, topics, consent evidence and any suppression.

> "Unsubscribe [bob@example.com](mailto:bob@example.com) from product updates only."

The agent calls `unsubscribe_contact` with `scope: "topic"`. Someone who unsubscribed is never re-added unless you explicitly confirm fresh consent (`resubscribe`).

> "Add these five addresses to the 'Beta testers' list, creating contacts that don't exist yet."

The agent calls `add_list_members` with `emails` and `createMissing`; unsubscribed or suppressed addresses come back in `blocked`.

> "Who on the 'Beta testers' list would not receive a campaign, and why?"

The agent calls `list_list_members` with `filter: "suppressed"`; each member carries its `suppressionStatuses`.

See the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions) for the underlying endpoints. These tools need an API key with `contacts:read` and `contacts:write`.

## Troubleshooting [#troubleshooting]

### Server Not Starting [#server-not-starting]

Verify your API key is set:

```bash
echo $NORTHRELAY_API_KEY
```

Test the server manually:

```bash
NORTHRELAY_API_KEY=nr_live_xxx npx @northrelay/mcp-server
```

### Tools Not Appearing in AI Client [#tools-not-appearing-in-ai-client]

1. Restart your AI client after updating the configuration
2. Verify the configuration file path is correct for your OS
3. Check that `npx` is available in your system PATH

### Authentication Errors [#authentication-errors]

Ensure your API key:

* Starts with `nr_live_` (production) or `nr_test_` (testing)
* Has not been revoked
* Has the necessary permissions for the operations you are performing — a
  key missing a scope answers `403 SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT` naming the scope

### Hosted Endpoint Connects But Shows No Tools [#hosted-endpoint-connects-but-shows-no-tools]

* The client presented the wrong bearer: the server answers `401`, which most
  clients report as a failed connection. Check the token the client was given
  against `NORTHRELAY_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` on the host.
* The client was pointed at the host root instead of `/mcp`.
* Adding it as a claude.ai custom connector without `NORTHRELAY_MCP_PUBLIC_URL`
  set on the instance: that dialog cannot send a bearer token, so the
  instance has to run in [connector mode](#connector-mode).
* The connector reports "Couldn't register with … sign-in service", or
  connects but never offers to sign in: the instance's
  `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` is not reachable through the
  reverse proxy, or names a platform origin the client cannot reach.
  `curl -s https://mcp.example.net/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
  should answer with `authorization_servers`. A proxy that forwards only
  `/mcp` and `/healthz` has to forward that path too — the instance answers
  both the bare path and the `/mcp`-suffixed form, so with Caddy:

  ```text
  handle /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource* {
      reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:3010
  }
  ```

## Related [#related]

* [TypeScript SDK](/docs/sdks/typescript) for programmatic Node.js integration
* [Python SDK](/docs/sdks/python) for programmatic Python integration
* [API Reference](/docs/api-reference) for raw HTTP API details


# Python SDK



# Python SDK [#python-sdk]

The official NorthRelay Python SDK (`northrelay` 1.9.0) is an async client built on httpx, with Pydantic v2 models for requests and results.

**Requires Python 3.9+.** Every API method is a coroutine: call it with `await` inside an async function (FastAPI, Starlette, aiohttp, or `asyncio.run`).

## Installation [#installation]

```bash
pip install northrelay
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

```python
import asyncio
import os

from northrelay import NorthRelay, SendEmailRequest


async def main() -> None:
    async with NorthRelay(api_key=os.environ["NORTHRELAY_API_KEY"]) as client:
        response = await client.emails.send(
            SendEmailRequest(
                from_={"email": "you@yourdomain.com", "name": "Your App"},
                to=[{"email": "recipient@example.com"}],
                content={
                    "subject": "Hello from NorthRelay",
                    "html": "<h1>Welcome!</h1><p>Your first email via NorthRelay.</p>",
                },
            )
        )
        print("Queued:", response.message_id)


asyncio.run(main())
```

`async with` closes the HTTP connection pool on exit; without it, call `await client.close()` when you are done.

## Configuration [#configuration]

```python
client = NorthRelay(
    api_key="nr_live_xxx",                  # required: nr_live_, nr_test_ or nr_app_
    base_url="https://app.northrelay.ca",   # optional, defaults shown
    timeout=30.0,                           # seconds
    max_retries=3,
    retry_delay=1.0,                        # seconds, exponential backoff
    max_retry_delay=10.0,
)
```

| Option            | Type    | Default                     | Description                      |
| ----------------- | ------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `api_key`         | `str`   | *required*                  | Your NorthRelay API key          |
| `base_url`        | `str`   | `https://app.northrelay.ca` | API base URL                     |
| `timeout`         | `float` | `30.0`                      | Request timeout in seconds       |
| `max_retries`     | `int`   | `3`                         | Max attempts for retryable reads |
| `retry_delay`     | `float` | `1.0`                       | Initial retry delay in seconds   |
| `max_retry_delay` | `float` | `10.0`                      | Cap on the backoff delay         |

## Mailing Lists and Subscriptions [#mailing-lists-and-subscriptions]

See the [Mailing Lists guide](/docs/guides/mailing-lists) for the full integration and the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions) for request and response details. Results are Pydantic models with snake\_case attributes (`result.contact_id`, `status.unsubscribed_from_all`).

### Subscriptions [#subscriptions]

```python
from northrelay import NorthRelayError

# Subscribe with double opt-in and consent evidence (email is positional)
try:
    result = await client.subscriptions.subscribe(
        "jane@example.com",
        list_ids=["list_id"],
        topic_ids=["topic_id"],
        double_opt_in=True,
        redirect_url="https://yourapp.com/newsletter/confirmed",
        consent={"ip": "203.0.113.24", "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0 ...", "text": "Yes, send me the monthly newsletter."},
    )
    print(result.status, result.requires_confirmation, result.confirmation_sent)
except NorthRelayError as error:
    if error.details.get("code") == "RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED":
        ...  # retry with resubscribe=True only after fresh consent
    else:
        raise

# Preference page: read, then save changes
status = await client.subscriptions.get("jane@example.com")
for topic in status.topics:
    print(topic.id, topic.label or topic.name, topic.subscribed)

status = await client.subscriptions.update_preferences(
    "jane@example.com",
    topics={"topic_id": False},
    lists={"list_id": True},
)

# Opt out from your server: scope "all" (default), "list" or "topic"
result = await client.subscriptions.unsubscribe("jane@example.com", scope="topic", topic_id="topic_id")
print(result.changed)

# Re-send the confirmation email for a PENDING contact
sent = await client.subscriptions.resend_confirmation("jane@example.com")
print(sent.expires_at)
```

| Method                                                                                                                                                                                             | Endpoint                                          | Returns                    |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `subscriptions.subscribe(email, *, first_name, last_name, phone, list_ids, topic_ids, tags, custom_fields, metadata, double_opt_in, confirmation_template_id, redirect_url, resubscribe, consent)` | `POST /subscriptions`                             | `SubscribeResult`          |
| `subscriptions.subscribe_request(request)`                                                                                                                                                         | Same, with a prepared `SubscribeRequest`          | `SubscribeResult`          |
| `subscriptions.unsubscribe(email, *, scope, list_id, topic_id, reason)`                                                                                                                            | `POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`                 | `UnsubscribeResult`        |
| `subscriptions.get(email)`                                                                                                                                                                         | `GET /subscriptions/{email}`                      | `SubscriptionStatus`       |
| `subscriptions.update_preferences(email, *, topics, lists, unsubscribe_all, resubscribe, consent)`                                                                                                 | `PATCH /subscriptions/{email}`                    | `SubscriptionStatus`       |
| `subscriptions.resend_confirmation(email)`                                                                                                                                                         | `POST /subscriptions/{email}/resend-confirmation` | `ResendConfirmationResult` |

`consent` takes a dict (`ip`, `user_agent` or `userAgent`, `text`) or a `Consent` model. Emails are URL-encoded in paths for you. `unsubscribe` raises `ValueError` when `scope="list"` has no `list_id` or `scope="topic"` has no `topic_id`; `update_preferences` raises `ValueError` when none of `topics`, `lists` or `unsubscribe_all=True` is given. Subscription writes are not retried automatically.

### Contacts [#contacts]

```python
contact = await client.contacts.create(
    {"email": "user@example.com", "first_name": "Jane", "last_name": "Doe", "tags": ["trial"]}
)
page = await client.contacts.list(status="ACTIVE", tag="trial", limit=50)
contact = await client.contacts.update(contact.id, first_name="Janet")
await client.contacts.add_tags(contact.id, ["vip"])
await client.contacts.remove_tag(contact.id, "trial")
await client.contacts.bulk_upsert([{"email": "a@example.com"}, {"email": "b@example.com"}], skip_duplicates=True)
await client.contacts.bulk_delete(["contact_id_1", "contact_id_2"])
await client.contacts.delete(contact.id)
```

`contacts.create()` does not record consent or fire webhooks; use `subscriptions.subscribe()` when a person signs up. `bulk_upsert` creates new contacts and skips existing ones; it does not update them.

### Lists and members [#lists-and-members]

```python
lst = await client.contacts.create_list("Product updates", topic_id="topic_id")  # tag with a topic

added = await client.contacts.add_to_list(lst.id, emails=["jane@example.com", "new@example.com"], create_missing=True)
print(added.added, added.already_members, added.not_found, added.blocked)

members = await client.contacts.list_members(lst.id, filter="active", limit=100)
print(members.counts, members.total, members.has_more)

await client.contacts.remove_from_list(lst.id, emails=["jane@example.com"])
```

| Method                                                                                                         | Endpoint                                                       |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `contacts.list_lists(*, page, limit, type, search, archived)`                                                  | `GET /contacts/lists`                                          |
| `contacts.get_list(id)` / `create_list(name, description, *, type, topic_id, tracking_enabled, segment_rules)` | `/contacts/lists`                                              |
| `contacts.update_list(id, name, description, *, topic_id, tracking_enabled, is_archived)`                      | `PATCH /contacts/lists/{id}` (`topic_id=None` removes the tag) |
| `contacts.delete_list(id)`                                                                                     | `DELETE /contacts/lists/{id}` (archives)                       |
| `contacts.list_members(id, *, page, limit, filter)` (alias `get_list_members`)                                 | `GET /contacts/lists/{id}/members`                             |
| `contacts.add_to_list(id, contact_ids=None, *, emails, create_missing)`                                        | `POST /contacts/lists/{id}/members`                            |
| `contacts.remove_from_list(id, contact_ids=None, *, emails)`                                                   | `DELETE /contacts/lists/{id}/members`                          |

`remove_from_list` is the list owner removing someone (the membership is deleted). To record that a recipient asked to leave, use `subscriptions.unsubscribe(email, scope="list", list_id=...)`.

### CSV import [#csv-import]

```python
result = await client.contacts.import_csv(
    "subscribers.csv",                     # path, or the CSV content as bytes
    mappings=[{"csvColumn": "Email Address", "field": "email"}, {"csvColumn": "First", "field": "firstName"}],
    list_id="list_id",
    tags=["imported", "spring-2026"],
)
print(result.imported, result.skipped, result.added_to_list, result.errors)
```

When `mappings` is omitted, columns named like email, first name, last name and phone are mapped automatically. `file_name` sets the upload name when you pass bytes.

### Topics (suppression groups) [#topics-suppression-groups]

`client.topics` is an alias of `client.suppression_groups`. A topic member is an address that **opted out** of that topic. Topic methods return the API response as a dict.

```python
topic = await client.topics.create("product-updates", "Release notes")
topic_id = topic["data"]["id"]

await client.topics.update(
    topic_id,
    public_label="Product updates",
    public_description="New features, about twice a month.",
    is_published_on_unsub=True,
)

published = await client.topics.list(published=True)
opt_outs = await client.topics.list_members(topic_id, page=1, limit=25)
await client.topics.add_member(topic_id, "jane@example.com")     # opt out
await client.topics.remove_member(topic_id, "jane@example.com")  # opt back in
```

The member methods only edit the opt-out rows. For a recipient's own choice, prefer `subscriptions.unsubscribe(..., scope="topic")` or `update_preferences`, which also update tagged lists and fire webhooks.

### Signup forms [#signup-forms]

Form methods return the `data` object of the API response as a dict.

```python
created = await client.forms.create(list_id="list_id", name="Newsletter", slug="newsletter")
form_id = created["form"]["id"]

await client.forms.update(form_id, status="PUBLISHED", require_confirmation=True, success_redirect_url="https://yourapp.com/thanks")
await client.forms.set_fields(form_id, [
    {"fieldKey": "email", "label": "Email", "type": "EMAIL", "required": True, "bindsToContact": "EMAIL"},
    {"fieldKey": "first_name", "label": "First name", "type": "TEXT", "bindsToContact": "FIRST_NAME"},
])
forms = await client.forms.list(limit=20)
await client.forms.delete(form_id)  # archives the form
```

`forms.submit(form_id, values)` posts answers keyed by `fieldKey` to a published form. From your own backend, `subscriptions.subscribe()` is usually the better choice.

### Webhooks [#webhooks]

```python
from northrelay import CreateWebhookRequest, UpdateWebhookRequest, WebhookEventType

webhook = await client.webhooks.create(
    CreateWebhookRequest(
        url="https://yourapp.com/webhooks/northrelay",
        events=[WebhookEventType.CONTACT_UNSUBSCRIBED, WebhookEventType.LIST_MEMBER_REMOVED, "email.bounced"],
        description="Newsletter sync",
    )
)
print(webhook.secret)  # shown once: store it

await client.webhooks.update(webhook.id, UpdateWebhookRequest(active=False))
new_secret = await client.webhooks.rotate_secret(webhook.id)
await client.webhooks.delete(webhook.id)
```

`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPES` lists every event name the API accepts.

### Suppressions [#suppressions]

```python
await client.suppressions.add("optout@example.com")              # reason defaults to "Manual"
await client.suppressions.add("bounced@example.com", reason="Bounce")
status = await client.suppressions.check("optout@example.com")   # 404 NotFoundError when not suppressed
await client.suppressions.remove("optout@example.com")
page = await client.suppressions.list()
```

Emails are URL-encoded in paths for you. `reason` is one of `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual`. To record a recipient's own opt-out, prefer `subscriptions.unsubscribe()`.

## Error Handling [#error-handling]

```python
from northrelay import (
    AuthenticationError,
    NorthRelayError,
    NotFoundError,
    QuotaExceededError,
    RateLimitError,
    ScopeError,
    ServerError,
    ValidationError,
)

try:
    await client.subscriptions.subscribe("jane@example.com", list_ids=["list_id"])
except RateLimitError as e:
    print(f"Rate limited. Retry after {e.retry_after} seconds.")
except ValidationError as e:
    print("Validation failed:", e.message, e.errors)
except NotFoundError as e:
    print(e.details.get("code"), e.details.get("fix_action"))  # e.g. LIST_NOT_FOUND
except NorthRelayError as e:
    print(e.status_code, e.details.get("code"), e.details.get("fix_action"))
```

Every exception carries `message`, `status_code` and `details`; `details` holds the API's `code`, `fix_action` and `docs_url`.

| Exception             | When                                                                                                                           | Extra attributes            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| `AuthenticationError` | Missing or invalid API key (401)                                                                                               | —                           |
| `ScopeError`          | 403, including `SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT` and `FREE_TIER_CONTACT_LIMIT`                                                              | —                           |
| `ValidationError`     | 400                                                                                                                            | `errors`                    |
| `NotFoundError`       | 404, including `LIST_NOT_FOUND`, `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`, `CONTACT_NOT_FOUND`                                                        | —                           |
| `QuotaExceededError`  | Monthly quota exceeded (429)                                                                                                   | `quota_limit`, `quota_used` |
| `RateLimitError`      | Rate limit exceeded (429)                                                                                                      | `retry_after`               |
| `ServerError`         | 5xx                                                                                                                            | —                           |
| `NetworkError`        | The request did not reach the API                                                                                              | —                           |
| `NorthRelayError`     | Any other status, including 409 `RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED`, `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`, `CONTACT_BLOCKED`, `NO_PENDING_CONFIRMATION` | `status_code`, `details`    |

## Automatic Retries [#automatic-retries]

Reads are retried on `ServerError`, `NetworkError` and `RateLimitError` with a `retry_after`, using exponential backoff from `retry_delay` capped at `max_retry_delay` (or the `retry_after` value). Writes to contacts, lists, subscriptions, topics, forms and webhooks are not retried automatically.

## Webhook Verification [#webhook-verification]

NorthRelay signs each delivery with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body, hex-encoded, in the `X-NorthRelay-Signature` header. Verify it with the standard library, then parse the body into the SDK's `WebhookPayload` model:

```python
import hashlib
import hmac
import os

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
from northrelay import WebhookPayload

app = FastAPI()
SECRET = os.environ["NORTHRELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET"]


@app.post("/webhooks/northrelay")
async def northrelay_webhook(request: Request):
    raw = await request.body()
    expected = hmac.new(SECRET.encode(), raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, request.headers.get("X-NorthRelay-Signature", "")):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid signature")

    event = WebhookPayload.model_validate_json(raw)
    if event.event_type == "contact.unsubscribed":
        scope = event.details.get("scope")          # "all" | "list" | "topic"
        email = event.details.get("contactEmail")
        ...
    return {"received": True}
```

# TypeScript SDK



# TypeScript SDK [#typescript-sdk]

The official NorthRelay TypeScript SDK (`@northrelay/sdk` 1.9.0) wraps the NorthRelay REST API with typed requests and responses, automatic retries for safe calls, and webhook signature helpers.

## Installation [#installation]

```bash
npm install @northrelay/sdk
```

```bash
yarn add @northrelay/sdk
```

```bash
pnpm add @northrelay/sdk
```

## Quick Start [#quick-start]

```typescript
import { NorthRelayClient } from '@northrelay/sdk';

const client = new NorthRelayClient({
  apiKey: process.env.NORTHRELAY_API_KEY!,
});

const response = await client.emails.send({
  from: { email: 'you@yourdomain.com', name: 'Your App' },
  to: [{ email: 'recipient@example.com' }],
  content: {
    subject: 'Hello from NorthRelay',
    html: '<h1>Welcome!</h1><p>Your first email via NorthRelay.</p>',
  },
});

console.log('Queued:', response.data.messageId);
```

## Configuration [#configuration]

```typescript
const client = new NorthRelayClient({
  // Required
  apiKey: 'nr_live_xxx',

  // Optional — defaults shown
  baseUrl: 'https://app.northrelay.ca',
  timeout: 30000,    // milliseconds
  maxRetries: 3,     // retries for retryable failures
  retryDelay: 1000,  // base delay in milliseconds (exponential backoff, capped at 10 s)
});
```

| Option       | Type     | Default                     | Description                                                   |
| ------------ | -------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apiKey`     | `string` | *required*                  | Your NorthRelay API key (`nr_live_`, `nr_test_` or `nr_app_`) |
| `baseUrl`    | `string` | `https://app.northrelay.ca` | API base URL (HTTPS, no credentials in the URL)               |
| `timeout`    | `number` | `30000`                     | Request timeout in milliseconds                               |
| `maxRetries` | `number` | `3`                         | Max retry attempts for retryable failures                     |
| `retryDelay` | `number` | `1000`                      | Base delay between retries in milliseconds                    |

### Responses [#responses]

Most methods resolve to the API's response envelope, `{ success: true, data }`, so read results from `data`:

```typescript
const { data } = await client.subscriptions.get('jane@example.com');
```

Contact-list routes return `{ data }` (and `pagination` for lists), and `importCsv` returns the import result directly. The return type of every method says which shape you get.

## Mailing Lists and Subscriptions [#mailing-lists-and-subscriptions]

See the [Mailing Lists guide](/docs/guides/mailing-lists) for the full integration and the [Subscriptions API](/docs/api-reference/subscriptions) for request and response details.

### Subscriptions [#subscriptions]

```typescript
import { isSubscriptionError } from '@northrelay/sdk';

// Subscribe with double opt-in and consent evidence
try {
  const { data } = await client.subscriptions.subscribe({
    email: 'jane@example.com',
    listIds: ['list_id'],
    topicIds: ['topic_id'],
    doubleOptIn: true,
    redirectUrl: 'https://yourapp.com/newsletter/confirmed',
    consent: { ip: '203.0.113.24', userAgent: 'Mozilla/5.0 ...', text: 'Yes, send me the monthly newsletter.' },
  });
  // data.status is 'PENDING' until the recipient confirms
} catch (error) {
  if (isSubscriptionError(error, 'RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED')) {
    // they unsubscribed earlier: retry with resubscribe: true only after fresh consent
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}

// Preference page: read, then save changes
const { data: status } = await client.subscriptions.get('jane@example.com');
await client.subscriptions.updatePreferences('jane@example.com', {
  topics: { topic_id: false },
  lists: { list_id: true },
});

// Opt out from your server: scope 'all' (default), 'list' or 'topic'
await client.subscriptions.unsubscribe({ email: 'jane@example.com', scope: 'list', listId: 'list_id' });

// Re-send the confirmation email for a PENDING contact
await client.subscriptions.resendConfirmation('jane@example.com');
```

| Method                                            | Endpoint                                          | Returns `data`             |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `subscriptions.subscribe(request)`                | `POST /subscriptions`                             | `SubscribeResult`          |
| `subscriptions.unsubscribe(request)`              | `POST /subscriptions/unsubscribe`                 | `UnsubscribeResult`        |
| `subscriptions.get(email)`                        | `GET /subscriptions/{email}`                      | `SubscriptionStatus`       |
| `subscriptions.updatePreferences(email, request)` | `PATCH /subscriptions/{email}`                    | `SubscriptionStatus`       |
| `subscriptions.resendConfirmation(email)`         | `POST /subscriptions/{email}/resend-confirmation` | `ResendConfirmationResult` |

Emails are URL-encoded in paths for you. `isSubscriptionError(error, code?)` returns `true` for a `NorthRelayError` whose `code` is one of `LIST_NOT_FOUND`, `TOPIC_NOT_FOUND`, `CONTACT_NOT_FOUND`, `CONTACT_BLOCKED`, `RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`, `RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED`, `NO_PENDING_CONFIRMATION`, `FREE_TIER_CONTACT_LIMIT` or `VALIDATION_ERROR` (optionally a specific one). `subscribe` and `resendConfirmation` are never retried automatically, because a retry could send a second confirmation email.

### Contacts [#contacts]

```typescript
const { data: contact } = await client.contacts.create({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  firstName: 'Jane',
  lastName: 'Doe',
  tags: ['trial'],
  metadata: { plan: 'trial' },
});

const page = await client.contacts.list({ status: 'ACTIVE', tag: 'trial', limit: 50 });
await client.contacts.update(contact.id, { firstName: 'Janet' });
await client.contacts.addTags(contact.id, ['vip']);
await client.contacts.removeTag(contact.id, 'trial');
await client.contacts.bulkCreate([{ email: 'a@example.com' }, { email: 'b@example.com' }], { skipDuplicates: true });
await client.contacts.bulkDelete(['contact_id_1', 'contact_id_2']);
await client.contacts.delete(contact.id);
```

`contacts.list()` filters by `status`, `tag`, `search`, `source`, `sortBy` and `sortOrder`. It does not filter by list; use `getListMembers(listId)`. `contacts.create()` does not record consent or fire webhooks; use `subscriptions.subscribe()` when a person signs up.

### Lists and members [#lists-and-members]

```typescript
const { data: list } = await client.contacts.createList({
  name: 'Product updates',
  suppressionGroupId: 'topic_id', // tag the list with a topic
});

const added = await client.contacts.addListMembers(list.id, {
  emails: ['jane@example.com', 'new@example.com'],
  createMissing: true,
});
// added.data: { added, alreadyMembers, notFound, blocked }

const members = await client.contacts.getListMembers(list.id, { filter: 'active', page: 1, limit: 100 });
// members: { data, counts: { total, active, suppressed }, pagination }

await client.contacts.removeListMembers(list.id, { emails: ['jane@example.com'] });
```

| Method                                                                                        | Endpoint                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `contacts.listLists({ page, limit, type, isArchived, search })`                               | `GET /contacts/lists`                          |
| `contacts.getList(id)` / `createList(request)` / `updateList(id, request)` / `deleteList(id)` | `/contacts/lists/{id}` (delete archives)       |
| `contacts.getListMembers(id, { page, limit, filter })`                                        | `GET /contacts/lists/{id}/members`             |
| `contacts.addListMembers(id, { contactIds?, emails?, createMissing? })`                       | `POST /contacts/lists/{id}/members`            |
| `contacts.removeListMembers(id, { contactIds?, emails? })`                                    | `DELETE /contacts/lists/{id}/members`          |
| `contacts.addToList(id, contactIdsOrInput)` / `removeFromList(id, contactIdsOrInput)`         | Shorthands that accept an array of contact ids |

`removeListMembers` is the list owner removing someone (the membership is deleted). To record that a recipient asked to leave, use `subscriptions.unsubscribe({ email, scope: 'list', listId })`.

### CSV import [#csv-import]

```typescript
const result = await client.contacts.importCsv(csvTextOrBlob, {
  mappings: [
    { csvColumn: 'Email Address', field: 'email' },
    { csvColumn: 'First', field: 'firstName' },
  ],
  listId: 'list_id',
  tags: ['imported', 'spring-2026'],
});
// result: { imported, skipped, addedToList, errors }
```

`importCsv` accepts a `Blob`/`File` or the CSV text. `mappings` is required.

### Topics (suppression groups) [#topics-suppression-groups]

A topic member is an address that **opted out** of that topic.

```typescript
const { data: topic } = await client.suppressionGroups.create({ name: 'product-updates', description: 'Release notes' });
await client.suppressionGroups.update(topic.id, {
  publicLabel: 'Product updates',
  publicDescription: 'New features, about twice a month.',
  isPublishedOnUnsub: true,
});

const published = await client.suppressionGroups.list({ published: true });
const optOuts = await client.suppressionGroups.listMembers(topic.id, { page: 1, limit: 25 });
await client.suppressionGroups.addMember(topic.id, 'jane@example.com');    // opt out
await client.suppressionGroups.removeMember(topic.id, 'jane@example.com'); // opt back in
```

The member methods only edit the opt-out rows. For a recipient's own choice, prefer `subscriptions.unsubscribe({ scope: 'topic', topicId })` or `updatePreferences`, which also update tagged lists and fire webhooks. `bulkAddSuppressions(id, emails)` and `bulkRemoveSuppressions(id, emails)` change up to 10,000 opt-outs at once.

### Signup forms [#signup-forms]

```typescript
const { data: { form } } = await client.forms.create({ listId: 'list_id', name: 'Newsletter', slug: 'newsletter' });
await client.forms.update(form.id, { status: 'PUBLISHED', requireConfirmation: true, successRedirectUrl: 'https://yourapp.com/thanks' });
await client.forms.setFields(form.id, [
  { fieldKey: 'email', label: 'Email', type: 'EMAIL', required: true, bindsToContact: 'EMAIL' },
  { fieldKey: 'first_name', label: 'First name', type: 'TEXT', bindsToContact: 'FIRST_NAME' },
]);
const forms = await client.forms.list({ limit: 20 });
await client.forms.archive(form.id);
```

`forms.submit(id, values)` posts answers keyed by `fieldKey` to a published form. From your own backend, `subscriptions.subscribe()` is usually the better choice.

### Webhooks [#webhooks]

```typescript
const { webhook, secret } = await client.webhooks.create({
  url: 'https://yourapp.com/webhooks/northrelay',
  events: ['contact.subscribed', 'contact.confirmed', 'contact.unsubscribed', 'list.member_removed', 'email.bounced'],
  description: 'Newsletter sync',
});
// secret is returned only here: store it

const { webhooks } = await client.webhooks.list();
const { webhook: current, stats } = await client.webhooks.get(webhook.id);
await client.webhooks.update(webhook.id, { active: false });     // { webhook, message }

const rotated = await client.webhooks.rotateSecret(webhook.id);   // { id, secret, previousSecretValidUntil }
const test = await client.webhooks.testDelivery(webhook.id);     // { success, statusCode?, responseTime?, error? }
await client.webhooks.delete(webhook.id);                        // { message }
```

The webhook routes return their own shapes rather than the `{ success, data }` envelope, as shown above. `create` is not retried automatically. After `rotateSecret`, deliveries also carry `X-NorthRelay-Signature-Previous` (signed with the old secret) until `previousSecretValidUntil`, one hour later. `events` is typed as `WebhookEventType[]`. See [Webhook verification](#webhook-verification) for the receiving side.

### Suppressions [#suppressions]

```typescript
await client.suppressions.add({ email: 'optout@example.com', reason: 'Manual' });
await client.suppressions.bulkAdd(['a@example.com', 'b@example.com']);            // reason defaults to 'Manual'
await client.suppressions.bulkAdd(['bounced@example.com'], 'Bounce');
await client.suppressions.bulkRemove(['a@example.com']);
await client.suppressions.remove('optout@example.com');                          // email is URL-encoded for you
const page = await client.suppressions.list({ page: 1, limit: 25 });
```

`reason` is one of `Bounce`, `Complaint`, `Unsubscribe` or `Manual`. To record a recipient's own opt-out, prefer `subscriptions.unsubscribe()`.

## Error Handling [#error-handling]

API failures are thrown as `NorthRelayError` or one of its subclasses. Every error carries `code`, `statusCode`, `fixAction` and `docsUrl` when the API supplied them.

```typescript
import { NorthRelayError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, isSubscriptionError } from '@northrelay/sdk';

try {
  await client.subscriptions.subscribe({ email: 'jane@example.com', listIds: ['list_id'] });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof RateLimitError) {
    console.log(`Rate limited. Retry after ${error.retryAfter} seconds.`);
  } else if (error instanceof ValidationError) {
    console.log('Validation failed:', error.message, error.validationErrors);
  } else if (isSubscriptionError(error)) {
    console.log(error.code, error.fixAction); // e.g. RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED
  } else if (error instanceof NorthRelayError) {
    console.error(error.code, error.statusCode, error.message);
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

| Error class           | When                                                                                                    | Extra properties                             |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `AuthenticationError` | Missing or invalid API key (401)                                                                        | —                                            |
| `ScopeError`          | The key lacks the required scope (403 `SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT`)                                             | `requiredScopes`                             |
| `ValidationError`     | Request failed validation (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`)                                                      | `validationErrors`                           |
| `QuotaExceededError`  | Monthly quota exceeded                                                                                  | `quota`                                      |
| `RateLimitError`      | Rate limit exceeded (429)                                                                               | `retryAfter` (seconds)                       |
| `NotFoundError`       | Resource not found (404)                                                                                | —                                            |
| `ServerError`         | NorthRelay server error (5xx)                                                                           | —                                            |
| `NetworkError`        | The request did not reach the API                                                                       | —                                            |
| `NorthRelayError`     | Any other API error, including the subscription codes (`RECIPIENT_UNSUBSCRIBED`, `LIST_NOT_FOUND`, ...) | `code`, `statusCode`, `fixAction`, `docsUrl` |

## Automatic Retries [#automatic-retries]

Read calls and idempotent writes are retried on network errors and HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503 and 504, with exponential backoff from `retryDelay` (capped at 10 seconds) or the `Retry-After` header. Calls that could duplicate a side effect are not retried: `subscriptions.subscribe`, `subscriptions.resendConfirmation`, `contacts.create`, `contacts.bulkCreate`, `contacts.importCsv`, `contacts.createList` and the form create and submit calls.

## Webhook Verification [#webhook-verification]

NorthRelay signs each delivery with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body in the `X-NorthRelay-Signature` header. Verify against the raw body, before parsing it.

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { parseWebhookPayload, verifyWebhookSignature } from '@northrelay/sdk';

const app = express();

app.post('/webhooks/northrelay', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), (req, res) => {
  const raw = req.body.toString('utf8');
  const signature = req.header('x-northrelay-signature') ?? '';

  let event;
  try {
    // Throws when the signature is invalid; returns a typed WebhookPayload
    event = parseWebhookPayload(raw, signature, process.env.NORTHRELAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET!);
  } catch {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
  }

  switch (event.eventType) {
    case 'contact.unsubscribed':
      // event.details.scope is 'all' | 'list' | 'topic'
      markOptedOut(event.details.contactEmail, event.details.scope, event.details.listId ?? event.details.topicId);
      break;
    case 'list.member_added':
      syncMember(event.details.listId, event.details.email);
      break;
    case 'email.clicked':
      recordClick(event.details.email, event.details.url);
      break;
  }

  res.status(200).json({ received: true });
});

// Or only check the signature:
const ok = verifyWebhookSignature(rawBody, signatureHeader, secret); // boolean
```

## TypeScript Types [#typescript-types]

Request, response and webhook types are exported:

```typescript
import type {
  ClientConfig,
  SendEmailRequest,
  Contact,
  ContactList,
  SubscribeRequest,
  SubscribeResult,
  SubscriptionStatus,
  UpdatePreferencesRequest,
  SubscriptionErrorCode,
  WebhookEventType,
  WebhookPayload,
  ContactUnsubscribedWebhook,
} from '@northrelay/sdk';
```
